from pathlib import Path
import argparse, hashlib, json, os, statistics, subprocess, sys, time

W = Path('/tmp/ferro-run')
OUT = W / 'property-stage5'
HERE = Path('/workspace/scratch/6f70b20c54b6/FerroUI/scripts/themes/bench')
DOC = Path('/tmp/ferro496-base/docs/benchmarks/compiled-theme-binding-dispatch-linux-x86_64.json')
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
from compare_registration import (digest, dependency_artifacts, native_linker_identity,
    prepare_native_capture, read_native_capture, paired_ratio)
from compact_unwind_link import RESERVE, inspect

LANES = ['metadata_default', 'metadata_scoped', 'metadata_cached_override',
    'get_plain', 'get_derived_default', 'get_mixed_hosts', 'get_effective_local',
    'mixed_75read_25write', 'style_set_read_dispose', 'style_binding_emit_read', 'coerce_scoped_local']

def parse(text):
    rows = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        lane, operations, checksum, cpu, wall = line.split()
        operations, checksum, cpu, wall = map(int, [operations, checksum, cpu, wall])
        assert lane in LANES and operations == (20_000 if lane in LANES[-3:] else 200_000)
        assert cpu > 0 and wall > 0
        rows.append({'lane': lane, 'operations': operations, 'checksum': checksum,
                     'thread_cpu_ns': cpu, 'wall_ns': wall})
    assert len(rows) == len(LANES) and {r['lane'] for r in rows} == set(LANES)
    return rows

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
mode.add_argument('--build-only', action='store_true')
mode.add_argument('--measure-only', action='store_true')
parser.add_argument('--cpu', type=int, default=4)
parser.add_argument('--pairs', type=int, default=31)
args = parser.parse_args()
os.sched_setaffinity(0, {args.cpu})
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
g = Path((W / 'path').read_text())
source = OUT / 'property_workload.rs'
original_source = json.loads(DOC.read_text())['property']['property_workload_source']
assert source.read_text() == original_source, 'fixture must be the exact existing workload source'
env = {**os.environ,
    'PATH': '/tmp/ferro-tools/bin:/tmp/ferro-tools/lib/rustlib/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin/gcc-ld:' + os.environ.get('PATH', ''),
    'FERROUI_CC': '/usr/bin/cc', 'RAYON_NUM_THREADS': '1', 'MALLOC_ARENA_MAX': '1',
    'MALLOC_CONF': 'narenas:1,tcache:false,dirty_decay_ms:0,muzzy_decay_ms:0,background_thread:false,retain:false',
    'LLVM_PROFILE_FILE': os.devnull,
}
for name in ['FERROUI_PGO_TRAIN', 'RUSTFLAGS', 'CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS',
             'RUSTC_WRAPPER', 'RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER',
             'FERROUI_BENCH_EXPECT_NORMAL_FONT_SIZE', 'FERROUI_BENCH_EXPECT_COMPACT_FONT_SIZE']:
    env.pop(name, None)
rustc = '/tmp/ferro-tools/bin/rustc'
toolchain = subprocess.check_output([rustc, '-vV'], env=env, text=True)
native_linker = native_linker_identity(rustc, 'x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu', env)
graphs = {'reference': W / 'baseline-graph', 'candidate': W / 'stage5-graph'}
profiles = {'reference': g / '736840a1a89cda4724cbc66d7e6e8bf525be704f769fc12027b6a9ca4ddbe709.profdata',
            'candidate': Path(json.loads((W / 'stage5-retraining.json').read_text())['profile']['path'])}
host = W / 'registration-host-deps'
host_artifacts = dependency_artifacts(host)
assert host_artifacts == json.loads((host / 'hashes.json').read_text())
report = {
    'scope': 'Existing eleven-lane property workload used in original training, explicitly separate from held-out binding/registration cohorts. Shipping main does not embed this dispatch; these are standalone companions using the exact source, target graphs and corresponding profiles. No new workload or training. Timings never use instrumented artifacts.',
    'policy': 'Production opt-z/FatLTO/one codegen unit, panic unwind, safe ICF, RELR and verified compact unwind. Two warmup pairs,31 alternating fresh-process pairs pinned to one CPU; existing source rotates the eleven lanes by its numeric argument. Thread CPU ns per operation; wall durations and checksums retained.',
    'source': {'path': str(source), 'sha256': digest(source), 'document': str(DOC),
               'document_sha256': digest(DOC), 'json_pointer': '/property/property_workload_source'},
    'recipe': {'path': str(Path(__file__)), 'sha256': digest(Path(__file__))},
    'helper': {'path': str(HERE / 'compare_registration.py'), 'sha256': digest(HERE / 'compare_registration.py')},
    'toolchain': toolchain, 'native_linker': native_linker,
    'profile_output': os.devnull, 'cpu': args.cpu, 'pairs': args.pairs,
    'inputs': {}, 'builds': {}, 'smoke': {},
}
for label in ['reference', 'candidate']:
    graph, profile = graphs[label], profiles[label]
    base, = graph.glob('libferroui_base-*.rlib')
    rlibs = dependency_artifacts(graph)
    assert {k: v for k, v in rlibs.items() if k.endswith('.rlib')} == json.loads((graph / 'hashes.json').read_text())
    inputs = {'graph': str(graph), 'graph_hashes_sha256': digest(graph / 'hashes.json'),
        'rlib_sha256': rlibs, 'base': str(base), 'base_sha256': digest(base),
        'profile': str(profile), 'profile_sha256': digest(profile),
        'host_dependencies': str(host), 'host_dependency_manifest_sha256': digest(host / 'hashes.json'), 'host_dependency_artifacts_sha256': host_artifacts}
    report['inputs'][label] = inputs
    binary = OUT / (label + '-property')
    manifest = binary.with_suffix('.json')
    command = [rustc, str(source), '--edition=2021', '--crate-name', 'property_probe',
        '--target', 'x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu', '-Cpanic=unwind', '-Copt-level=z',
        '-Clto=fat', '-Ccodegen-units=1', '-Cprofile-use=' + str(profile),
        '-Cllvm-args=--addrsig', '-Cstrip=symbols', '-Clink-arg=-fuse-ld=lld',
        '-Clink-arg=-Wl,--icf=safe', '-Clink-arg=-Wl,-z,pack-relative-relocs',
        '-Clinker=' + str(HERE / 'compact_unwind_link.py'),
        '-Ldependency=' + str(graph), '-Ldependency=' + str(host),
        '--extern', 'ferroui_base=' + str(base), '-o', str(binary)]
    build_env, capture = prepare_native_capture(binary, env, native_linker['cc'], args.measure_only)
    identity = {'command': command, 'source_sha256': digest(source), 'inputs': inputs,
        'toolchain': toolchain, 'native_linker': native_linker, 'native_capture': capture,
        'linker_source_sha256': {name: digest(HERE / name) for name in
            ['compact_unwind_link.py', 'compact_unwind.py', 'attribute_codegen.py']}}
    if args.build_only:
        assert not manifest.exists(), 'refuse to replace a prior fixture build'
        start = time.monotonic()
        with binary.with_suffix('.log').open('w') as log:
            result = subprocess.run(command, env=build_env, stdout=log, stderr=log)
        saved = {'identity': identity, 'compile_exit': result.returncode,
                 'build_seconds': time.monotonic() - start}
        manifest.write_text(json.dumps(saved, indent=2))
        if result.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError(label + ' property companion compile failed')
        saved.update(path=str(binary), bytes=binary.stat().st_size, sha256=digest(binary),
            compact_unwind_applied=RESERVE in inspect(binary)[2], native_capture=read_native_capture(capture))
        assert saved['compact_unwind_applied'], 'required compact-unwind policy did not apply'
        manifest.write_text(json.dumps(saved, indent=2))
    else:
        saved = json.loads(manifest.read_text())
        assert saved['identity'] == identity and saved['sha256'] == digest(binary), label
        assert saved['native_capture'] == read_native_capture(capture), label
    report['builds'][label] = saved

if args.build_only:
    for label in ['reference', 'candidate']:
        command = [str(OUT / (label + '-property')), '0']
        result = subprocess.run(command, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
        assert result.returncode == 0, (label, result.stderr)
        rows = parse(result.stdout)
        report['smoke'][label] = {'command': command, 'exit': result.returncode,
            'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr, 'rows': rows,
            'note': 'Build verification only; not a timing cohort.'}
    assert [(r['lane'], r['operations'], r['checksum']) for r in report['smoke']['reference']['rows']] == [(r['lane'], r['operations'], r['checksum']) for r in report['smoke']['candidate']['rows']]
    (OUT / 'build.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
    print('Both property companions built; compact unwind applied; all eleven smoke checksums agree.', flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(0)

report['build_manifest'] = {'path': str(OUT / 'build.json'), 'sha256': digest(OUT / 'build.json')}
report['raw_samples'] = {'reference': [], 'candidate': []}
report['samples'] = {label: {lane: [] for lane in LANES} for label in ['reference', 'candidate']}
for round_index in range(-2, args.pairs):
    order = ['reference', 'candidate'] if round_index % 2 == 0 else ['candidate', 'reference']
    pair = {}
    for label in order:
        command = [str(OUT / (label + '-property')), str(abs(round_index))]
        result = subprocess.run(command, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
        assert result.returncode == 0, (label, round_index, result.stderr)
        rows = parse(result.stdout)
        pair[label] = rows
        if round_index >= 0:
            report['raw_samples'][label].append({'round': round_index, 'command': command,
                'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr, 'rows': rows})
            for row in rows:
                report['samples'][label][row['lane']].append(row['thread_cpu_ns'] / row['operations'])
    assert [(r['lane'], r['operations'], r['checksum']) for r in pair['reference']] == [(r['lane'], r['operations'], r['checksum']) for r in pair['candidate']], round_index
report['comparisons'] = {lane: {
    'reference_median_ns': statistics.median(report['samples']['reference'][lane]),
    'candidate_median_ns': statistics.median(report['samples']['candidate'][lane]),

    for lane in LANES}
output = W / ('stage5-property-' + str(args.cpu) + '.json')
output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
print(json.dumps(report['comparisons'], indent=2), flush=True)

"""Bounded mixed-property follow-up using the two unchanged stage5 companions."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import itertools
import json
import os
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import time

W = Path('/tmp/ferro-run')
HERE = Path('/workspace/scratch/6f70b20c54b6/FerroUI/scripts/themes/bench')
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
from compare_registration import digest, paired_ratio

LANES = ['metadata_default', 'metadata_scoped', 'metadata_cached_override',
         'get_plain', 'get_derived_default', 'get_mixed_hosts', 'get_effective_local',
         'mixed_75read_25write', 'style_set_read_dispose', 'style_binding_emit_read',
         'coerce_scoped_local']
MIXED = 'mixed_75read_25write'
ARMS = ['reference', 'candidate', 'reference_control']
ORDERS = list(itertools.permutations(ARMS))
BLOCKS = 31
WARMUPS = 3


def file_identity(path):
    path = Path(path)
    return {'path': str(path), 'sha256': digest(path), 'bytes': path.stat().st_size}


def parse(text, rotation):
    rows = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        lane, operations, checksum, cpu, wall = line.split()
        operations, checksum, cpu, wall = map(int, [operations, checksum, cpu, wall])
        assert lane in LANES and operations == (20_000 if lane in LANES[-3:] else 200_000)
        assert cpu > 0 and wall > 0
        rows.append({'lane': lane, 'operations': operations, 'checksum': checksum,
                     'thread_cpu_ns': cpu, 'wall_ns': wall})
    assert [row['lane'] for row in rows] == LANES[rotation:] + LANES[:rotation]
    return rows


def signature(rows):
    return [[row['lane'], row['operations'], row['checksum']] for row in rows]


def run(cpu):
    output = W / f'stage5-mixed-property-control-{cpu}.json'
    assert not output.exists(), f'refuse to replace retained cohort: {output}'
    os.sched_setaffinity(0, {cpu})
    build_path = W / 'property-stage5/build.json'
    build = json.loads(build_path.read_text())
    assert digest(HERE / 'compare_registration.py') == build['helper']['sha256']
    assert digest(Path(build['source']['path'])) == build['source']['sha256']
    assert digest(Path(build['recipe']['path'])) == build['recipe']['sha256']
    for label in ['reference', 'candidate']:
        saved = build['builds'][label]
        assert saved['compile_exit'] == 0 and saved['compact_unwind_applied']
        assert digest(Path(saved['path'])) == saved['sha256']
        assert Path(saved['path']).stat().st_size == saved['bytes']
        inputs = build['inputs'][label]
        assert digest(Path(inputs['graph']) / 'hashes.json') == inputs['graph_hashes_sha256']
        assert digest(Path(inputs['base'])) == inputs['base_sha256']
        assert digest(Path(inputs['profile'])) == inputs['profile_sha256']
        assert digest(Path(inputs['host_dependencies']) / 'hashes.json') == inputs['host_dependency_manifest_sha256']
    env_overrides = {
        'PATH': '/tmp/ferro-tools/bin:/tmp/ferro-tools/lib/rustlib/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin/gcc-ld:' + os.environ.get('PATH', ''),
        'FERROUI_CC': '/usr/bin/cc', 'RAYON_NUM_THREADS': '1', 'MALLOC_ARENA_MAX': '1',
        'MALLOC_CONF': 'narenas:1,tcache:false,dirty_decay_ms:0,muzzy_decay_ms:0,background_thread:false,retain:false',
        'LLVM_PROFILE_FILE': os.devnull,
    }
    removed = ['FERROUI_PGO_TRAIN', 'RUSTFLAGS', 'CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS',
               'RUSTC_WRAPPER', 'RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER',
               'FERROUI_BENCH_EXPECT_NORMAL_FONT_SIZE', 'FERROUI_BENCH_EXPECT_COMPACT_FONT_SIZE']
    env = {**os.environ, **env_overrides}
    for name in removed:
        env.pop(name, None)
    identities = {}
    for arm in ARMS:
        source_arm = 'candidate' if arm == 'candidate' else 'reference'
        saved = build['builds'][source_arm]
        identities[arm] = {'source_arm': source_arm,
            'binary': {'path': saved['path'], 'sha256': saved['sha256'], 'bytes': saved['bytes']},
            'build_manifest_arm': source_arm,
            'same_image_as': 'reference' if arm == 'reference_control' else None}
    assert identities['reference']['binary'] == identities['reference_control']['binary']
    report = {
        'status': 'running', 'cpu': cpu, 'measured_blocks': BLOCKS, 'warmup_blocks': WARMUPS,
        'scope': 'Separate bounded follow-up for the original CPU7 mixed_75read_25write flag. Unchanged existing binaries and workload source; no link, source edit, profile generation or new performance lane. Other ten output lanes are retained and checked only for correctness.',
        'method': 'Three arms; all six arm permutations rotate by global block index. Each arm runs eleven fresh processes with rotation arguments0..10, summing only mixed-lane thread CPU and wall times across2,200,000 operations. This is a longer aggregate workload than the initial single-process cohort; it is not reported as unchanged duration. All original cohorts remain retained.',
        'statistical_method': {'estimator': 'median of per-block paired ratios',
            'bootstrap_resamples': 7000, 'random_seed': 9961,
            'interval_sorted_indices': [174, 6824],
            'helper': file_identity(HERE / 'compare_registration.py')},
        'producer': file_identity(Path(__file__)),
        'build_manifest': {**file_identity(build_path), 'contents': build},
        'provenance': {name: file_identity(W / name) for name in
            ['stage5-source.json', 'stage5-publication-map.json', 'stage5-retraining.json',
             'stage5-base/compiler.json', 'stage5-base/result.json']},
        'retained_initial_cohorts': {str(pin): file_identity(W / f'stage5-property-{pin}.json')
                                     for pin in [6, 7]},
        'environment': {'overrides': env_overrides, 'removed': removed,
                        'cpu_affinity': sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))},
        'identities': identities, 'arm_orders': [list(order) for order in ORDERS],
        'correctness_signatures_by_rotation': {}, 'blocks': [],
        'samples': {arm: [] for arm in ARMS}, 'started_unix': time.time(),
        'identity_verification_scope': 'Current binary, fixture, producer/helper, graph-inventory, Base and profile hashes checked before measurements. Full dependency/compiler/link/native-capture identities retained verbatim from the original build manifest; no dependency rebuild.',
    }
    expected = report['correctness_signatures_by_rotation']
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        for global_index, block_index in enumerate(range(-WARMUPS, BLOCKS)):
            order_index = global_index % len(ORDERS)
            block = {'block': block_index, 'global_index': global_index,
                     'warmup': block_index < 0, 'order_index': order_index,
                     'order': list(ORDERS[order_index]), 'arms': {}}
            report['blocks'].append(block)
            for arm in block['order']:
                row = {'invocations': [], 'operations': 0, 'thread_cpu_ns': 0,
                       'wall_ns': 0, 'checksum_sum': 0}
                block['arms'][arm] = row
                for rotation in range(len(LANES)):
                    command = [identities[arm]['binary']['path'], str(rotation)]
                    start = time.monotonic_ns()
                    result = subprocess.run(command, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
                    elapsed = time.monotonic_ns() - start
                    assert result.returncode == 0, (arm, block_index, rotation, result.stderr)
                    rows = parse(result.stdout, rotation)
                    sig = signature(rows)
                    key = str(rotation)
                    if key not in expected:
                        assert arm == 'reference' and block_index == -WARMUPS
                        expected[key] = {'signature': sig,
                            'established_by': {'arm': arm, 'block': block_index, 'rotation': rotation}}
                    assert sig == expected[key]['signature'], (arm, block_index, rotation)
                    if rotation == 0:
                        assert sig == signature(build['smoke']['reference']['rows'])
                    mixed, = [item for item in rows if item['lane'] == MIXED]
                    row['invocations'].append({'rotation': rotation, 'command': command,
                        'exit': result.returncode, 'process_elapsed_ns': elapsed,
                        'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr,
                        'rows': rows, 'correctness_signature': sig,
                        'performance_lane': MIXED})
                    for metric in ['operations', 'thread_cpu_ns', 'wall_ns']:
                        row[metric] += mixed[metric]
                    row['checksum_sum'] += mixed['checksum']
                assert row['operations'] == 2_200_000
                row['thread_cpu_ns_per_operation'] = row['thread_cpu_ns'] / row['operations']
                row['wall_ns_per_operation'] = row['wall_ns'] / row['operations']
                if block_index >= 0:
                    report['samples'][arm].append({key: value for key, value in row.items()
                                                  if key != 'invocations'})
            if block_index == -1:
                print(f'CPU{cpu}: three warmup blocks passed all correctness signatures.', flush=True)
        report['comparisons'] = {}
        for name, numerator, denominator in [
                ('candidate_reference', 'candidate', 'reference'),
                ('candidate_reference_control', 'candidate', 'reference_control'),
                ('reference_control_reference', 'reference_control', 'reference')]:
            report['comparisons'][name] = {}
            for metric in ['thread_cpu_ns_per_operation', 'wall_ns_per_operation']:
                nums = [sample[metric] for sample in report['samples'][numerator]]
                dens = [sample[metric] for sample in report['samples'][denominator]]
                assert len(nums) == len(dens) == BLOCKS
                report['comparisons'][name][metric] = {
                    'numerator_arm': numerator, 'denominator_arm': denominator,
                    'numerator_median': statistics.median(nums),
                    'denominator_median': statistics.median(dens),
                    'paired_ratio': paired_ratio(nums, dens)}
        for arm in ['reference', 'candidate']:
            assert digest(Path(identities[arm]['binary']['path'])) == identities[arm]['binary']['sha256']
        report.update(status='complete', all_correctness_signatures_match=True,
            total_invocations=(BLOCKS + WARMUPS) * len(ARMS) * len(LANES),
            total_checked_output_rows=(BLOCKS + WARMUPS) * len(ARMS) * len(LANES) ** 2)
    except BaseException as error:
        report.update(status='failed', error=repr(error))
        raise
    finally:
        report.update(elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - started, finished_unix=time.time())
        output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps({'cpu': cpu, 'comparisons': report['comparisons']}), flush=True)
    return {'cpu': cpu, 'output': file_identity(output), 'status': report['status'],
            'elapsed_seconds': report['elapsed_seconds']}


if __name__ == '__main__':
    run_path = W / 'stage5-mixed-property-control-run.json'
    assert not run_path.exists(), 'refuse to replace prior orchestration provenance'
    run_report = {'producer': file_identity(Path(__file__)),
                  'command': [sys.executable, *sys.argv], 'cpus': [6, 7],
                  'started_unix': time.time(), 'phases': []}
    try:
        for pin in [6, 7]:
            run_report['phases'].append(run(pin))
            run_path.write_text(json.dumps(run_report, indent=2) + '\n')
        run_report['exit'] = 0
    except BaseException as error:
        run_report.update(exit=1, error=repr(error))
        raise
    finally:
        run_report['finished_unix'] = time.time()
        run_path.write_text(json.dumps(run_report, indent=2) + '\n')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Assemble existing FerroUI continuation evidence; never build, benchmark, or decide promotion.

Draft mode permits missing/incomplete evidence in the selected later phases.
--final requires every configured slot to be present and structurally usable,
even if a measured gate failed. --final-phase selects the source snapshot used
for publication verification; it does not declare that phase accepted. Each
later phase keeps current-build and profile-training provenance separate, so reuse of an
earlier profile is never described as fresh training. Paths and JSON selectors
can be overridden with --config. Compact PGO/codegen audits are SHA-linked rather
than copying their LLVM/native records.
"""

import argparse
import copy
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import itertools
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys

from source_appendix import build_source_appendix

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = Path('/workspace/scratch/6f70b20c54b6/FerroUI')
RUN = Path('/tmp/ferro-run')
QA = Path('/tmp/recover-xaml/property-qa')
AUDIT = Path('/tmp/ferro496-conversion-audit')
OUTPUT = HERE / 'compiled-theme-rust-idioms-linux-x86_64.json'
REPOSITORY_AUDIT_PATHS = {
    'audit.pgo_key_drift': 'docs/benchmarks/compiled-theme-pgo-key-drift-linux-x86_64.json',
    'audit.conversion_codegen': 'docs/benchmarks/compiled-theme-conversion-codegen-linux-x86_64.json',
    'inline_hash.pgo_codegen_audit': 'docs/benchmarks/compiled-theme-hash-trial-pgo-linux-x86_64.json',
    'inline_hash.final_native_proof': 'docs/benchmarks/compiled-theme-hash-trial-native-linux-x86_64.json',
    'inline_clone.pgo_codegen_audit': 'docs/benchmarks/compiled-theme-clone-trial-codegen-linux-x86_64.json',
    'inline_clone.final_native_proof': 'docs/benchmarks/compiled-theme-clone-trial-native-linux-x86_64.json',
    'stage3.codegen_audit': 'docs/benchmarks/compiled-theme-stage3-codegen-linux-x86_64.json',
    'stage4.codegen_audit': 'docs/benchmarks/compiled-theme-stage4-codegen-linux-x86_64.json',
    'stage4.boxed_rejection_audit': 'docs/benchmarks/compiled-theme-stage4-rejected-boxed-linux-x86_64.json',
}
PHASE_NAMES = {'combined': 'combined_fixed_profile', 'stage2': 'stage2_fresh_profile',
               'stage3': 'stage3_fresh_profile', 'stage4': 'stage4_candidate', 'stage5': 'stage5_candidate'}
DRAFT_PHASES = {PHASE_NAMES['stage3'], PHASE_NAMES['stage4'], 'stage4_hot_reload_verification',
                'stage4_template_verification', 'stage4_boxed_rejection_followup',
                'static_weak_root_diagnostic', 'stage5_candidate', 'stage5_hot_reload_verification',
                'stage5_template_verification', 'stage5_boxed_rejection_followup',
                'stage5_borrowed_rejection_followup', 'stage5_source_guards', 'stage5_test_only_repair',
                'stage5_property_companion', 'stage5_mixed_property_followup', 'stage5_repository_observation'}
COMPAT_CASES = {'embedded', 'installed', 'scalar-v3', 'scalar-v2', 'scalar-v1',
                'two-edits-v3', 'struct-v3', 'struct-v2', 'struct-v1'}
BINDING_LANES = {'local_install', 'style_install', 'typed_notify', 'typed_writeback',
                 'typed_context', 'local_notify', 'style_notify'}
REGISTRATION_LANES = {'register_element', 'property_registration', 'boxed_live', 'borrowed_live',
                      'boxed_wrong', 'borrowed_wrong', 'boxed_expired', 'borrowed_expired'}
PROPERTY_LANES = ['metadata_default', 'metadata_scoped', 'metadata_cached_override',
                  'get_plain', 'get_derived_default', 'get_mixed_hosts', 'get_effective_local',
                  'mixed_75read_25write', 'style_set_read_dispose', 'style_binding_emit_read', 'coerce_scoped_local']
TEST_SUMMARY = re.compile(r'test result: (?P<result>\w+)\. (?P<passed>\d+) passed; '
                         r'(?P<failed>\d+) failed; (?P<ignored>\d+) ignored; '
                         r'(?P<measured>\d+) measured; (?P<filtered_out>\d+) filtered out; '
                         r'finished in (?P<seconds>[\d.]+)s')


def sha_bytes(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def file_identity(path):
    before = path.stat()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        sha = hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()
    after = path.stat()
    if (before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) != (after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns):
        raise ValueError(f'artifact changed while reading: {path}')
    return {'path': str(path), 'bytes': after.st_size, 'sha256': sha}


def pointer(data, value):
    if not value:
        return data
    if not value.startswith('/'):
        raise ValueError(f'JSON pointer must start with /: {value}')
    for part in value.split('/')[1:]:
        part = part.replace('~1', '/').replace('~0', '~')
        data = data[int(part)] if isinstance(data, list) else data[part]
    return data


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def summaries(text):
    result = []
    for match in TEST_SUMMARY.finditer(text):
        item = match.groupdict()
        for name in ('passed', 'failed', 'ignored', 'measured', 'filtered_out'):
            item[name] = int(item[name])
        item['seconds'] = float(item['seconds'])
        item['reported_line'] = match.group(0)
        result.append(item)
    require(result, 'no completed Rust test-result line')
    return result


def validate_property_rows(rows, round_index):
    require(isinstance(rows, list) and len(rows) == len(PROPERTY_LANES), 'incomplete property workload rows')
    expected_order = PROPERTY_LANES[round_index % len(PROPERTY_LANES):] + PROPERTY_LANES[:round_index % len(PROPERTY_LANES)]
    require([row.get('lane') for row in rows] == expected_order, 'property lane rotation differs from the recorded argument')
    for row in rows:
        require({'operations', 'checksum', 'thread_cpu_ns', 'wall_ns'} <= row.keys(), 'incomplete property result row')
        expected_operations = 20_000 if row['lane'] in PROPERTY_LANES[-3:] else 200_000
        require(row['operations'] == expected_operations and row['thread_cpu_ns'] > 0 and row['wall_ns'] > 0,
                'property operation-count/duration protocol mismatch')


def validate_mixed_property_control(data):
    required = {'status', 'cpu', 'measured_blocks', 'warmup_blocks', 'scope', 'method', 'statistical_method',
                'producer', 'build_manifest', 'provenance', 'retained_initial_cohorts', 'environment',
                'identities', 'arm_orders', 'correctness_signatures_by_rotation', 'blocks', 'samples',
                'comparisons', 'all_correctness_signatures_match', 'total_invocations', 'total_checked_output_rows'}
    require(required <= data.keys(), 'incomplete mixed-property control evidence')
    arms = {'reference', 'candidate', 'reference_control'}
    require(set(data['identities']) == set(data['samples']) == arms, 'missing mixed-property arm')
    require(data['identities']['reference']['binary'] == data['identities']['reference_control']['binary'],
            'mixed-property same-image control differs from the reference')
    orders = data['arm_orders']
    require(len(orders) == 6 and {tuple(order) for order in orders} == set(itertools.permutations(sorted(arms))),
            'mixed-property control does not retain all six arm orders')
    measured, warmup = data['measured_blocks'], data['warmup_blocks']
    require(isinstance(measured, int) and measured > 0 and isinstance(warmup, int) and warmup >= 0,
            'invalid mixed-property block counts')
    require(len(data['blocks']) == measured + warmup, 'mixed-property raw block count mismatch')
    require(set(data['correctness_signatures_by_rotation']) == {str(i) for i in range(len(PROPERTY_LANES))},
            'mixed-property correctness signatures are incomplete')
    for arm in arms:
        require(len(data['samples'][arm]) == measured, 'mixed-property measured sample count mismatch')
    invocations = 0
    output_rows = 0
    for global_index, block in enumerate(data['blocks']):
        index = global_index - warmup
        require(block['global_index'] == global_index and block['block'] == index
                and block['warmup'] == (index < 0) and block['order_index'] == global_index % len(orders)
                and block['order'] == orders[block['order_index']] and set(block['arms']) == arms,
                'mixed-property block/order protocol mismatch')
        for arm, result in block['arms'].items():
            require(len(result['invocations']) == len(PROPERTY_LANES), 'mixed-property rotation count mismatch')
            totals = dict.fromkeys(('operations', 'thread_cpu_ns', 'wall_ns', 'checksum_sum'), 0)
            for rotation, invocation in enumerate(result['invocations']):
                require(invocation['rotation'] == rotation
                        and invocation['command'] == [data['identities'][arm]['binary']['path'], str(rotation)]
                        and invocation['performance_lane'] == 'mixed_75read_25write',
                        'mixed-property invocation identity/rotation differs')
                validate_property_rows(invocation['rows'], rotation)
                signature = [[row['lane'], row['operations'], row['checksum']] for row in invocation['rows']]
                require(signature == invocation['correctness_signature']
                        == data['correctness_signatures_by_rotation'][str(rotation)]['signature'],
                        'mixed-property retained correctness signature differs')
                mixed = next(row for row in invocation['rows'] if row['lane'] == 'mixed_75read_25write')
                for metric in ('operations', 'thread_cpu_ns', 'wall_ns'):
                    totals[metric] += mixed[metric]
                totals['checksum_sum'] += mixed['checksum']
                invocations += 1
                output_rows += len(invocation['rows'])
            require(totals['operations'] == 2_200_000 and all(result[key] == value for key, value in totals.items()),
                    'mixed-property aggregate differs from its raw mixed-lane rows')
            for metric in ('thread_cpu_ns', 'wall_ns'):
                require(result[metric + '_per_operation'] == result[metric] / result['operations'],
                        'mixed-property normalized aggregate differs')
            if index >= 0:
                require(data['samples'][arm][index] == {key: value for key, value in result.items() if key != 'invocations'},
                        'mixed-property measured sample differs from its raw block')
    require(data['total_invocations'] == invocations and data['total_checked_output_rows'] == output_rows,
            'mixed-property reported invocation/row totals differ')
    require(set(data['comparisons']) == {'candidate_reference', 'candidate_reference_control', 'reference_control_reference'},
            'mixed-property comparison set differs')
    for comparison in data['comparisons'].values():
        require(set(comparison) == {'thread_cpu_ns_per_operation', 'wall_ns_per_operation'},
                'mixed-property comparison metrics differ')


def validate(kind, data):
    if kind == 'test_log':
        return {'reported_test_summaries': summaries(data), 'output': data}
    if kind == 'text_log':
        require(isinstance(data, str) and bool(data.strip()), 'empty textual evidence')
        return {'output': data}
    require(isinstance(data, (dict, list)) and bool(data), 'empty/non-object JSON evidence')
    if kind == 'compatibility':
        require(COMPAT_CASES <= data.keys(), 'missing compatibility case records')
        for name in COMPAT_CASES:
            require(isinstance(data[name].get('font'), list) and len(data[name]['font']) == 2,
                    f'{name}: missing two recorded font values')
            require('archive_sha256' in data[name], f'{name}: missing archive identity')
    elif kind == 'attribution':
        for key in ('shipping_bytes', 'shipping_sha256', 'attribution_method',
                    'text_and_unwind_disjoint_total_by_category', 'matched_sections'):
            require(key in data, f'missing attribution field {key}')
    elif kind == 'generated':
        require({'diff', 'candidate_files'} <= data.keys(), 'missing generated inventory/diff')
        for suffix in ('.rs', '.fxb', '.fxp'):
            require({'reference_count', 'candidate_count', 'reference_bytes', 'candidate_bytes',
                     'same_hashes', 'missing', 'added'} <= data['diff'][suffix].keys(),
                    f'incomplete {suffix} generated inventory')
    elif kind in ('retraining', 'profile_use_build'):
        require({'source', 'builds', 'profile', 'binary', 'graph'} <= data.keys(),
                'incomplete build/profile provenance')
        require(data['builds'], 'missing build records')
        require({'path', 'sha256'} <= data['profile'].keys(), 'incomplete profile identity')
        require({'path', 'sha256', 'bytes'} <= data['binary'].keys(), 'incomplete executable provenance')
        if kind == 'retraining':
            require({'method', 'training_runs'} <= data.keys() and data['training_runs'],
                    'missing training method/run records')
            require({'raw_files', 'raw_bytes'} <= data['profile'].keys(), 'incomplete training profile')
    elif kind == 'source':
        require('head' in data and ('source_hashes' in data or 'production_hashes' in data),
                'missing source revision/hashes')
    elif kind == 'qa_manifest':
        require({'source_sha256', 'base', 'base_sha256', 'cmd'} <= data.keys(), 'incomplete QA build provenance')
    elif kind == 'base_result':
        require({'base', 'sha256', 'bytes', 'argv', 'profile'} <= data.keys(), 'incomplete Base build provenance')
    elif kind == 'base_compiler':
        require({'argv', 'profile'} <= data.keys(), 'incomplete Base compiler provenance')
    elif kind == 'hot_reload_verification':
        required = {'cohort', 'release_source', 'release_base_sha256', 'profile_used', 'cfg',
                    'qa_source_hashes', 'qa_source_sha256', 'actual_base_source_hashes',
                    'base_command', 'base_compile', 'base', 'qa_command', 'qa_compile',
                    'qa_binary', 'required_reload_test', 'required_reload_test_listed', 'qa_list', 'qa_run',
                    'release_base_unchanged', 'release_graph_hashes_unchanged'}
        require(required <= data.keys(), 'development configuration verification is incomplete')
        require({'command', 'exit', 'counts', 'required_reload_test_passed'} <= data['qa_run'].keys(),
                'missing development test result')
        require({'command', 'exit'} <= data['qa_list'].keys(), 'missing development test listing command')
        require(isinstance(data['qa_run']['counts'], dict)
                and {'passed', 'failed', 'ignored'} <= data['qa_run']['counts'].keys(),
                'development test counts are unavailable')
    elif kind == 'template_verification':
        required = {'cohort', 'scope', 'prior_policy', 'source_derivation', 'source', 'recipe',
                    'release_source', 'release_source_sha256', 'release_graph',
                    'release_graph_hashes_sha256', 'release_base', 'dependencies', 'command',
                    'cfg', 'profile_used_on_companion', 'cpu', 'cases', 'expected_visual_tree_counts',
                    'expected_roots_per_control', 'activations_per_control_per_case', 'build', 'binary',
                    'release_graph_hashes_unchanged', 'release_base_unchanged'}
        require(required <= data.keys(), 'template companion verification is incomplete')
        require({'exit', 'seconds'} <= data['build'].keys(), 'missing companion build result')
        require({'path', 'sha256', 'bytes'} <= data['binary'].keys(), 'missing companion binary identity')
        require({'embedded', 'scalar', 'structural'} <= data['cases'].keys(), 'missing companion archive case')
        for name in ('embedded', 'scalar', 'structural'):
            require({'command', 'exit', 'stdout', 'stderr', 'archive', 'expected_font_sizes',
                     'expected_added_resource', 'nodes_including_control',
                     'all_root_and_tree_assertions_passed'} <= data['cases'][name].keys(),
                    f'{name}: incomplete template activation result')
    elif kind in ('boxed_rejection_followup', 'borrowed_rejection_followup'):
        required = {'method', 'source', 'manifest', 'cpu', 'blocks', 'iterations',
                    'elapsed_seconds', 'artifacts', 'raw', 'comparisons'}
        require(required <= data.keys(), 'incomplete boxed-rejection follow-up')
        labels = {'reference', 'candidate', 'reference_control'}
        lanes = {'boxed_wrong', 'boxed_live'} if kind == 'boxed_rejection_followup' else {'borrowed_wrong'}
        if kind == 'borrowed_rejection_followup':
            require(data.get('lanes') == ['borrowed_wrong'], 'borrowed follow-up must explicitly identify its one lane')
        require(set(data['artifacts']) == labels and set(data['raw']) == lanes,
                'incomplete follow-up binary or lane records')
        require(data['artifacts']['reference_control'] == data['artifacts']['reference'],
                'same-image control does not identify the exact reference executable')
        require(isinstance(data['blocks'], int) and data['blocks'] > 0
                and isinstance(data['iterations'], int) and data['iterations'] > 0,
                'invalid follow-up iteration/block count')
        for lane, rows in data['raw'].items():
            require(len(rows) == data['blocks'] and {row['block'] for row in rows} == set(range(data['blocks'])),
                    f'{lane}: missing follow-up blocks')
            require(len({tuple(row['order']) for row in rows}) == min(data['blocks'], 6),
                    f'{lane}: missing rotated process orders')
            for row in rows:
                require(len(row['order']) == 3 and set(row['order']) == labels
                        and set(row['results']) == labels, f'{lane}: incomplete process order/results')
                for result in row['results'].values():
                    require({'operations', 'checksum', 'thread_cpu_ns', 'wall_ns'} <= result.keys(),
                            f'{lane}: missing raw durations or result values')
                    require(result['operations'] == data['iterations'] and result['checksum'] == data['iterations'],
                            f'{lane}: operation/checksum protocol mismatch')
                    require(result['thread_cpu_ns'] > 0 and result['wall_ns'] > 0,
                            f'{lane}: nonpositive measured duration')
            for metric in ('thread_cpu_ns', 'wall_ns'):
                require({'medians_ns_per_operation', 'candidate_reference', 'candidate_reference_control',
                         'same_image_control_reference'} <= data['comparisons'][lane][metric].keys(),
                        f'{lane}: missing candidate/control comparisons')
    elif kind == 'mixed_property_control':
        validate_mixed_property_control(data)
    elif kind in ('property_build', 'property_timing'):
        required = {'scope', 'policy', 'source', 'recipe', 'helper', 'toolchain', 'native_linker',
                    'inputs', 'builds', 'smoke', 'cpu', 'pairs'}
        require(required <= data.keys(), 'incomplete property companion provenance')
        require(set(data['inputs']) == set(data['builds']) == {'reference', 'candidate'},
                'missing property companion arm')
        for side in ('reference', 'candidate'):
            require({'graph', 'graph_hashes_sha256', 'rlib_sha256', 'base', 'base_sha256',
                     'profile', 'profile_sha256', 'host_dependencies', 'host_dependency_manifest_sha256',
                     'host_dependency_artifacts_sha256'} <= data['inputs'][side].keys(),
                    f'{side}: incomplete property library/profile inputs')
            require({'identity', 'compile_exit', 'build_seconds', 'path', 'bytes', 'sha256',
                     'compact_unwind_applied', 'native_capture'} <= data['builds'][side].keys(),
                    f'{side}: incomplete property fixture build')
        if kind == 'property_build':
            require(set(data['smoke']) == {'reference', 'candidate'}, 'property build smoke evidence missing')
            for side in ('reference', 'candidate'):
                validate_property_rows(data['smoke'][side]['rows'], 0)
            require([(r['lane'], r['operations'], r['checksum']) for r in data['smoke']['reference']['rows']]
                    == [(r['lane'], r['operations'], r['checksum']) for r in data['smoke']['candidate']['rows']],
                    'property smoke checksum mismatch')
        else:
            require({'build_manifest', 'raw_samples', 'samples', 'comparisons'} <= data.keys(),
                    'missing property timing raw data')
            require(isinstance(data['pairs'], int) and data['pairs'] > 0, 'invalid property pair count')
            require(set(data['comparisons']) == set(PROPERTY_LANES), 'incomplete property lane comparisons')
            for side in ('reference', 'candidate'):
                require(len(data['raw_samples'][side]) == data['pairs']
                        and set(data['samples'][side]) == set(PROPERTY_LANES), 'incomplete property samples')
                require(all(len(values) == data['pairs'] for values in data['samples'][side].values()),
                        'property per-lane pair count mismatch')
                for index, sample in enumerate(data['raw_samples'][side]):
                    require(sample['round'] == index and sample['command'][-1] == str(index),
                            'property sample round differs from its actual command')
                    validate_property_rows(sample['rows'], index)
                    for row in sample['rows']:
                        require(data['samples'][side][row['lane']][index]
                                == row['thread_cpu_ns'] / row['operations'],
                                'property normalized sample differs from its raw row')
            for before, after in zip(data['raw_samples']['reference'], data['raw_samples']['candidate']):
                require([(r['lane'], r['operations'], r['checksum']) for r in before['rows']]
                        == [(r['lane'], r['operations'], r['checksum']) for r in after['rows']],
                        'property paired checksum mismatch')
    elif kind == 'source_guard':
        require({'command', 'source_sha256', 'elapsed_seconds', 'exit_code', 'output'} <= data.keys(),
                'incomplete original source-guard record')
    elif kind == 'scanner_repair':
        required = {'schema', 'status', 'scope', 'plan', 'recipe', 'patch', 'measured_source_commit',
                    'measured_source_snapshot', 'observed_head', 'observed_worktree_status',
                    'changed_tracked_paths_since_measured_source', 'recorded_source_hashes_before',
                    'current_source_hashes', 'expected_test_only_changes', 'scanner', 'idioms'}
        require(required <= data.keys() and data['schema'] == 'ferroui-scanner-test-only-repair-results-v1',
                'incomplete test-only scanner repair verification')
        for name in ('scanner', 'idioms'):
            require({'command', 'cwd', 'exit_code', 'elapsed_seconds', 'stdout', 'stderr'} <= data[name].keys(),
                    f'missing {name} verification result')
        summaries(data['scanner']['stdout'] + data['scanner']['stderr'])
    elif kind == 'verification':
        require({'command', 'compile_exit', 'source_sha256', 'base_sha256', 'run_exit', 'output'} <= data.keys(),
                'incomplete compile/run verification record')
        if 'test result:' in data['output']:
            summaries(data['output'])
    elif kind == 'graph':
        require(all(isinstance(v, str) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', v) for v in data.values()),
                'invalid graph hash inventory')
    elif kind in ('startup', 'startup_clean'):
        require({'embedded', 'scalar-v3', 'struct-v3', 'fallback-v1'} <= data.keys(), 'missing full-app lane')
        for lane in ('embedded', 'scalar-v3', 'struct-v3', 'fallback-v1'):
            item = data[lane]
            require({'samples_ns', 'median_ms', 'p95_ms', 'paired_ratio'} <= item.keys(), 'incomplete startup lane')
            a, b = item['samples_ns']['reference'], item['samples_ns']['candidate']
            require(a and len(a) == len(b) and all(x > 0 for x in a + b), 'invalid startup sample cohort')
            if kind == 'startup_clean':
                require({'protocol', 'samples', 'phase_diagnostics'} <= item.keys(), 'missing final startup protocol/phase samples')
                require({'expect_variables_present', 'cpu', 'pairs', 'reference_sha256', 'candidate_sha256'} <= item['protocol'].keys(),
                        'missing final startup protocol identities')
                require(all(len(item['samples'][side]) == item['protocol']['pairs'] for side in ('reference', 'candidate')),
                        'final startup phase sample count differs from recorded pairs')
    elif kind in ('binding', 'startup_repeat', 'startup_repeat_clean', 'registration', 'diagnostic_registration'):
        require({'samples'} <= data.keys(), 'missing benchmark samples')
        require({'reference', 'candidate'} <= data['samples'].keys(), 'missing paired benchmark cohorts')
        if kind in ('startup_repeat', 'startup_repeat_clean'):
            require({'cpu', 'pairs', 'paired_ratio', 'phase_diagnostics'} <= data.keys(), 'incomplete startup repeat')
            for values in data['samples'].values():
                require(len(values) == data['pairs'], 'startup pair-count mismatch')
                require(all({'create_ns', 'button_lookup_ns', 'create_and_button_ns', 'process_ready_ns',
                             'process_ns'} <= x.keys() for x in values), 'missing startup phase samples')
            if kind == 'startup_repeat_clean':
                require('expect_variables_present' in data, 'missing startup expectation-variable protocol record')
        else:
            lanes = BINDING_LANES if kind == 'binding' else REGISTRATION_LANES
            count = data['rounds'] if kind == 'binding' else data['pairs']
            for values in data['samples'].values():
                require(lanes <= values.keys(), 'missing benchmark lanes')
                require(all(len(values[lane]) == count for lane in lanes), 'benchmark pair-count mismatch')
            require('checksums' in data, 'missing benchmark result checksums')
            if kind == 'registration':
                require({'raw_samples', 'builds', 'inputs', 'interface_warmed_allocations', 'comparisons'} <= data.keys(),
                        'incomplete registration raw data/provenance')
                for values in data['raw_samples'].values():
                    require(lanes | {'interfaces'} <= values.keys(), 'missing registration raw lanes')
                    require(all(len(values[lane]) == count for lane in lanes | {'interfaces'}), 'raw pair-count mismatch')
            elif kind == 'diagnostic_registration':
                require({'reference_build', 'candidate_build', 'comparisons'} <= data.keys(), 'incomplete diagnostic provenance')
    elif kind == 'static_weak_root_audit_reference':
        require(data.get('schema') == 'ferroui-static-weak-root-diagnostic-audit-v1',
                'unknown static weak-root audit schema')
        require({'trial_result', 'source', 'optimized_base', 'root_profile', 'final_native'} <= data.keys(),
                'incomplete static weak-root audit')
        native = data['final_native']
        require(isinstance(native, dict) and {'binary_sha256', 'native_object_sha256',
                'fixture_manifest_sha256', 'capture_manifest_sha256', 'base_sha256',
                'profile_sha256', 'identity_checks', 'code_checks', 'passed'} <= native.keys(),
                'static weak-root final native evidence still unavailable')
    elif kind == 'final_codegen_reference':
        require(data.get('schema') in ('ferroui-final-conversion-pgo-audit-v1',
                                       'ferroui-final-conversion-pgo-audit-v2'),
                'unknown final codegen audit schema')
        require(isinstance(data.get('optimized_base'), dict) and data['optimized_base'], 'optimized Base audit still unavailable')
        native = data.get('final_native_lookup')
        require(isinstance(native, dict) and native, 'final native lookup audit still unavailable')
        require({'binary', 'binary_sha256', 'native_object', 'native_object_sha256', 'functions', 'passed'} <= native.keys(),
                'incomplete final native lookup evidence')
        if data['schema'].endswith('-v2'):
            clone = native.get('boxed_clone')
            require(isinstance(clone, dict) and {'public_body_present', 'outlined_symbols', 'relocations',
                    'nested_borrowed_clone_symbols', 'nested_borrowed_clone_relocations',
                    'public_disassembly', 'passed'} <= clone.keys(), 'incomplete final native clone evidence')
    return data
