def selected_view(kind, data):
    if kind in ('reference', 'final_codegen_reference', 'static_weak_root_audit_reference'):
        return None
    if kind == 'attribution':
        keys = ('source', 'compiler', 'target', 'profile_use', 'shipping_bytes', 'shipping_sha256',
                'attribution_method', 'text_and_unwind_disjoint_total_by_category', 'matched_sections', 'embedded_archive')
        return {key: data[key] for key in keys if key in data}
    if kind == 'historical_release':
        release = data['verified_release']
        return {'reference': data['reference'], 'timings': data['timings'],
                'verified_release': {key: value for key, value in release.items() if key != 'native_proofs'}}
    return data


def check_static_weak_root(data, evidence, integrity):
    prefix = 'static_weak_root.'
    if prefix + 'base_build' not in data:
        return
    build = data[prefix + 'base_build']
    if 'stage4.source' in data:
        expected = dict(data['stage4.source']['source_hashes'])
        source_path = 'src/FerroUI.Base/data/core/value_type.rs'
        require(build['source_before_sha256'] == expected[source_path],
                'static weak-root: before-source differs from stage4')
        expected[source_path] = build['source_after_sha256']
        require(build['actual_source_hashes'] == expected,
                'static weak-root: changed-source set differs from the single reviewed file')
    if 'stage4.build_provenance' in data:
        require(build['profile_sha256'] == data['stage4.build_provenance']['profile']['sha256'],
                'static weak-root: inherited profile differs from stage4')
    if 'stage4.base_result' in data:
        require(build['baseline_base_sha256'] == data['stage4.base_result']['sha256'],
                'static weak-root: baseline Base differs from stage4')
    if prefix + 'source_review' in data:
        review = data[prefix + 'source_review']
        require(review['source']['frozen_stage4_sha256'] == build['source_before_sha256']
                and review['source']['candidate_sha256'] == build['source_after_sha256']
                and review['patch']['sha256'] == build['patch_sha256'],
                'static weak-root: pre-execution review names a different source or patch')
    if prefix + 'graph' in data:
        graph = data[prefix + 'graph']
        require(graph[Path(build['base']).name] == build['base_sha256'],
                'static weak-root: Base differs from its trial graph')
        if 'stage4.graph' in data:
            baseline = data['stage4.graph']
            require(set(graph) == set(baseline), 'static weak-root: target graph inventory changed')
            changed = [name for name in graph if graph[name] != baseline[name]]
            require(changed == build['changed_graph_artifacts'] == [Path(build['base']).name],
                    'static weak-root: graph changes are not confined to Base')
            require(build['baseline_graph_hashes_sha256'] == evidence['stage4.graph']['sha256'],
                    'static weak-root: frozen graph manifest differs from stage4')
    for suffix, field in (('compiler', 'target_compiler'), ('host_compiler', 'host_compiler')):
        if prefix + suffix in data:
            require(data[prefix + suffix] == build[field],
                    f'static weak-root: {suffix} differs from its build record')
    if prefix + 'base_recipe' in evidence and evidence[prefix + 'base_recipe']['available']:
        require(evidence[prefix + 'base_recipe']['sha256'] == build['recipe_sha256'],
                'static weak-root: retained Base recipe differs from build provenance')
    fixture = data.get(prefix + 'fixture_build')
    if fixture:
        require(fixture['identity']['base_sha256'] == build['base_sha256']
                and fixture['identity']['profile_sha256'] == build['profile_sha256'],
                'static weak-root: fixture Base/profile differs from its diagnostic build')
        if prefix + 'link_capture' in data:
            require(fixture['link_capture'] == data[prefix + 'link_capture'],
                    'static weak-root: standalone capture differs from the fixture manifest')
    normalized = data.get(prefix + 'long_inputs')
    if normalized:
        for name, artifact in (('candidate_manifest', 'fixture_build'),
                               ('reference_manifest', 'reference_fixture'), ('trial_base_result', 'base_build')):
            require(normalized['inputs'][name]['sha256'] == evidence[prefix + artifact]['sha256'],
                    f'static weak-root: normalized input differs from {artifact}')
        for side, artifact in (('candidate', 'fixture_build'), ('reference', 'reference_fixture')):
            require(normalized['builds'][side]['registration'] == data[prefix + artifact],
                    f'static weak-root: normalized {side} build differs')
        if 'stage4.registration_build' in data:
            require(normalized['builds']['reference']['registration']['sha256']
                    == data['stage4.registration_build']['builds']['reference']['registration']['sha256'],
                    'static weak-root: reference executable differs from the stage4 reference')
    short = data.get(prefix + 'registration_cpu6')
    if short and fixture:
        require(short['candidate_build']['sha256'] == fixture['sha256'],
                'static weak-root: short comparison uses a different candidate')
        if prefix + 'reference_fixture' in data:
            require(short['reference_build']['sha256'] == data[prefix + 'reference_fixture']['sha256'],
                    'static weak-root: short comparison uses a different reference')
    for cpu in (6, 7):
        key = prefix + f'longer_cpu{cpu}'
        if key in data and normalized:
            run = data[key]
            require(run['cpu'] == cpu and run['manifest']['sha256'] == evidence[prefix + 'long_inputs']['sha256'],
                    f'{key}: CPU/input manifest differs')
            for side in ('reference', 'candidate'):
                require(run['artifacts'][side]['sha256'] == normalized['builds'][side]['registration']['sha256'],
                        f'{key}: {side} executable differs from normalized input')
    audit = data.get(prefix + 'pgo_codegen_audit')
    if audit:
        require(audit['trial_result']['sha256'] == evidence[prefix + 'base_build']['sha256']
                and audit['source']['trial_sha256'] == build['source_after_sha256']
                and audit['optimized_base']['sha256'] == build['base_sha256'],
                'static weak-root: native/profile audit source or Base differs from build')
        if fixture:
            native = audit['final_native']
            require(native['binary_sha256'] == fixture['sha256']
                    and native['fixture_manifest_sha256'] == evidence[prefix + 'fixture_build']['sha256']
                    and native['capture_manifest_sha256'] == evidence[prefix + 'link_capture']['sha256'],
                    'static weak-root: final native proof identifies a different fixture/capture')
    integrity.append({'phase': 'static_weak_root_diagnostic',
                      'relationship': 'single-file scratch patch, replacement Base, inherited profile, fixture/capture and available timing records are checked within this diagnostic',
                      'source_before_sha256': build['source_before_sha256'],
                      'source_after_sha256': build['source_after_sha256'],
                      'base_sha256': build['base_sha256'], 'inherited_profile_sha256': build['profile_sha256'],
                      'scope': 'No current worktree is reread as the historical trial source, and no whole-application acceptance is inferred.'})


def check_stage_companions(prefix, original_data, evidence, integrity):
    hot_key = f'{prefix}.hot_reload_manifest'
    if hot_key in original_data:
        hot = original_data[hot_key]
        if f'{prefix}.source' in original_data:
            source = original_data[f'{prefix}.source']['source_hashes']
            require(hot['release_source']['source_hashes'] == source
                    and hot['actual_base_source_hashes'] == source,
                    f'development verification source differs from its {prefix} snapshot')
        if f'{prefix}.graph' in original_data:
            release_bases = [sha for name, sha in original_data[f'{prefix}.graph'].items()
                             if name.startswith('libferroui_base-') and name.endswith('.rlib')]
            require(release_bases == [hot['release_base_sha256']],
                    'development verification names a different release Base input')
        test_key = f'{prefix}.hot_reload_tests'
        if test_key in original_data:
            reported = original_data[test_key]['reported_test_summaries'][-1]
            require(all(reported[key] == hot['qa_run']['counts'][key] for key in ('passed', 'failed', 'ignored')),
                    'development test log counts differ from its manifest')
            observed_pass = bool(re.search(r'^test (?:\w+::)*' + re.escape(hot['required_reload_test'])
                                          + r' \.\.\. ok$', original_data[test_key]['output'], re.MULTILINE))
            require(observed_pass == hot['qa_run']['required_reload_test_passed'],
                    'development required-test result differs from its manifest')
        list_key = f'{prefix}.hot_reload_list'
        if list_key in original_data:
            observed_listing = bool(re.search(r'^(?:\w+::)*' + re.escape(hot['required_reload_test'])
                                             + r': test$', original_data[list_key]['output'], re.MULTILINE))
            require(observed_listing == hot['required_reload_test_listed'],
                    'development required-test listing differs from its manifest')
        integrity.append({'phase': f'{prefix}_hot_reload_verification',
                          'relationship': f'separate development source and results identify the recorded {prefix} source snapshot',
                          'development_base_sha256': hot['base']['sha256'],
                          'release_base_sha256': hot['release_base_sha256']})

    template_key = f'{prefix}.templates_manifest'
    if template_key in original_data:
        template = original_data[template_key]
        input_identities = [(f'{prefix}.source', template['release_source_sha256']),
                            (f'{prefix}.graph', template['release_graph_hashes_sha256']),
                            (f'{prefix}.templates_source', template['source']['sha256']),
                            (f'{prefix}.templates_recipe', template['recipe']['sha256'])]
        if 'log_capture_postprocess' in template:
            postprocess = template['log_capture_postprocess']
            input_identities.extend([
                (f'{prefix}.templates_postprocess_recipe', postprocess['recipe_sha256']),
                (f'{prefix}.templates_original_manifest', postprocess['original_manifest_sha256']),
            ])
        for key, expected in input_identities:
            if key in evidence and evidence[key]['available']:
                require(evidence[key]['sha256'] == expected, f'template companion input identity differs: {key}')
        if f'{prefix}.base_result' in original_data:
            require(template['release_base']['sha256'] == original_data[f'{prefix}.base_result']['sha256'],
                    'template companion names a different optimized release Base')
        if f'{prefix}.graph' in original_data:
            graph = original_data[f'{prefix}.graph']
            for name, dependency in template['dependencies'].items():
                require(graph[Path(dependency['path']).name] == dependency['sha256'],
                        f'template companion dependency differs from its release graph: {name}')
        for name, case in template['cases'].items():
            key = f'{prefix}.templates_{name}_log'
            if key in original_data:
                require(original_data[key]['output'] == case['stdout'] + case['stderr'],
                        f'template companion retained output differs from manifest: {name}')
                if 'log' in case:
                    require(evidence[key]['sha256'] == case['log']['sha256'],
                            f'template companion retained log hash differs: {name}')
        if f'{prefix}.templates_original_manifest' in original_data:
            executed = {key: value for key, value in template.items() if key != 'log_capture_postprocess'}
            executed['cases'] = {name: {key: value for key, value in case.items() if key not in ('stderr', 'log')}
                                 for name, case in template['cases'].items()}
            require(executed == original_data[f'{prefix}.templates_original_manifest'],
                    'template log derivation changed the original execution record')
        integrity.append({'phase': f'{prefix}_template_verification',
                          'relationship': 'separate companion inputs identify the recorded final source and optimized dependency graph',
                          'release_base_sha256': template['release_base']['sha256'],
                          'companion_sha256': template['binary']['sha256'],
                          'reported_scope': template['scope']})

    for route in ('boxed', 'borrowed'):
        for cpu in (6, 7):
            key = f'{prefix}.{route}_rejection_cpu{cpu}'
            if key not in original_data:
                continue
            followup = original_data[key]
            require(followup['cpu'] == cpu, f'{key}: recorded CPU differs from its evidence slot')
            recipe = evidence[f'{prefix}.{route}_rejection_recipe']
            if recipe['available']:
                require(followup['source']['sha256'] == recipe['sha256'],
                        f'{key}: recorded follow-up recipe differs from retained text')
            original_keys = [f'{prefix}.registration_cpu{pin}' for pin in (6, 7)]
            manifest_keys = [f'{prefix}.registration_build', *original_keys]
            origins = [name for name in manifest_keys if evidence[name]['available']
                       and evidence[name]['sha256'] == followup['manifest']['sha256']]
            require(len(origins) == 1, f'{key}: no exact retained registration manifest matches the follow-up input')
            origin = original_data[origins[0]]
            for label in ('reference', 'candidate'):
                require(followup['artifacts'][label]['sha256'] == origin['builds'][label]['registration']['sha256'],
                        f'{key}: {label} binary differs from the original registration build')
                for original_key in original_keys:
                    if evidence[original_key]['available']:
                        require(original_data[original_key]['builds'][label]['registration']['sha256']
                                == followup['artifacts'][label]['sha256'],
                                f'{key}: {label} binary differs from {original_key}')
            integrity.append({'phase': f'{prefix}_{route}_rejection_followup', 'artifact': key,
                              'input_manifest_artifact': origins[0],
                              'related_original_cohort_artifacts': [name for name in original_keys if evidence[name]['available']],
                              'relationship': 'longer follow-up uses the original unchanged binaries and an identical reference control; original measurements remain separate'})

    if f'{prefix}.publication_map' in original_data:
        bridge = original_data[f'{prefix}.publication_map']
        require(bridge['captured_manifest_sha256'] == evidence[f'{prefix}.source']['sha256']
                and bridge['source_hashes'] == original_data[f'{prefix}.source']['source_hashes'],
                f'publication bridge differs from the unchanged measured {prefix} snapshot')
        build_key = f'{prefix}.build_provenance'
        if 'profile' in bridge and build_key in original_data:
            require(bridge['profile']['sha256'] == original_data[build_key]['profile']['sha256'],
                    f'publication bridge profile differs from {prefix} build provenance')
        if 'profile_provenance' in bridge and evidence.get(build_key, {}).get('available'):
            require(bridge['profile_provenance'] == evidence[build_key]['path'],
                    f'publication bridge profile provenance path differs from {prefix} build record')
        recipe_key = f'{prefix}.source_mapping_recipe'
        if 'producer' in bridge and evidence.get(recipe_key, {}).get('available'):
            require(bridge['producer']['sha256'] == evidence[recipe_key]['sha256'],
                    f'publication bridge producer differs from retained {prefix} recipe')
        integrity.append({'phase': PHASE_NAMES[prefix],
                          'relationship': 'separate publication bridge preserves the measured source/profile identities',
                          'bridge_artifact': f'{prefix}.publication_map',
                          'published_commit': bridge['published_commit']})



def check_property_companion(original_data, evidence, integrity):
    manifest_key = 'stage5.property_manifest'
    if manifest_key not in original_data:
        return
    manifest = original_data[manifest_key]
    for key, expected in (
            ('stage5.property_source', manifest['source']['sha256']),
            ('stage5.property_source_origin', manifest['source']['document_sha256']),
            ('stage5.property_recipe', manifest['recipe']['sha256'])):
        if evidence.get(key, {}).get('available'):
            require(evidence[key]['sha256'] == expected, f'{key}: property producer identity differs')
    require(manifest['source']['json_pointer'] == '/property/property_workload_source',
            'property fixture names an unexpected historical source pointer')
    for side, graph_key in (('reference', 'baseline.graph'), ('candidate', 'stage5.graph')):
        build_key = f'stage5.property_{side}_build'
        build = manifest['builds'][side]
        inputs = manifest['inputs'][side]
        if build_key in original_data:
            require(original_data[build_key] == build, f'{build_key}: per-arm and combined build records differ')
        require(build['identity']['inputs'] == inputs
                and build['identity']['source_sha256'] == manifest['source']['sha256'],
                f'{side}: property build identity differs from its declared source/inputs')
        if graph_key in original_data:
            rlibs = {name: sha for name, sha in inputs['rlib_sha256'].items() if name.endswith('.rlib')}
            require(rlibs == original_data[graph_key]
                    and inputs['graph_hashes_sha256'] == evidence[graph_key]['sha256'],
                    f'{side}: property libraries differ from the phase graph')
        if 'stage5.registration_build' in original_data:
            registration = original_data['stage5.registration_build']['inputs'][side]
            require(inputs['profile_sha256'] == registration['profile_sha256'],
                    f'{side}: property and registration fixtures use different phase profiles')
    if 'stage5.build_provenance' in original_data:
        require(manifest['inputs']['candidate']['profile_sha256']
                == original_data['stage5.build_provenance']['profile']['sha256'],
                'property fixture does not use the stage5 final profile')
    if 'stage5.base_result' in original_data:
        require(manifest['inputs']['candidate']['base_sha256'] == original_data['stage5.base_result']['sha256'],
                'property fixture does not use the stage5 optimized Base')
    for cpu in (6, 7):
        key = f'stage5.property_cpu{cpu}'
        if key not in original_data:
            continue
        run = original_data[key]
        require(run['cpu'] == cpu and run['build_manifest']['sha256'] == evidence[manifest_key]['sha256'],
                f'{key}: CPU or original build-manifest identity differs')
        for field in ('source', 'recipe', 'helper', 'inputs', 'builds', 'toolchain', 'native_linker'):
            require(run[field] == manifest[field], f'{key}: {field} changed after the property build')
        for side in ('reference', 'candidate'):
            for sample in run['raw_samples'][side]:
                require(sample['command'][0] == manifest['builds'][side]['path'],
                        f'{key}: measured command names a different {side} executable')
    for cpu in (6, 7):
        key = f'stage5.mixed_property_cpu{cpu}'
        if key not in original_data:
            continue
        run = original_data[key]
        require(run['cpu'] == cpu and run['build_manifest']['sha256'] == evidence[manifest_key]['sha256']
                and run['build_manifest']['contents'] == manifest,
                f'{key}: mixed-property control identifies a different CPU/build')
        require(run['producer']['sha256'] == evidence['stage5.mixed_property_recipe']['sha256']
                and run['statistical_method']['helper']['sha256'] == manifest['helper']['sha256'],
                f'{key}: mixed-property producer/helper differs from retained source')
        for pin in (6, 7):
            origin_key = f'stage5.property_cpu{pin}'
            if evidence.get(origin_key, {}).get('available'):
                require(run['retained_initial_cohorts'][str(pin)]['sha256'] == evidence[origin_key]['sha256'],
                        f'{key}: original short property cohort differs')
        for filename, origin_key in (
                ('stage5-source.json', 'stage5.source'), ('stage5-publication-map.json', 'stage5.publication_map'),
                ('stage5-retraining.json', 'stage5.build_provenance'),
                ('stage5-base/compiler.json', 'stage5.base_compiler'), ('stage5-base/result.json', 'stage5.base_result')):
            if evidence.get(origin_key, {}).get('available'):
                require(run['provenance'][filename]['sha256'] == evidence[origin_key]['sha256'],
                        f'{key}: original {filename} provenance differs')
        for side in ('reference', 'candidate'):
            binary = run['identities'][side]['binary']
            require(all(binary[field] == manifest['builds'][side][field] for field in ('path', 'sha256', 'bytes')),
                    f'{key}: existing {side} binary identity differs')
        integrity.append({'phase': 'stage5_mixed_property_followup', 'artifact': key,
                          'relationship': 'unchanged property binaries and actual final-library provenance; original short cohorts retained separately',
                          'original_cohort_artifacts': ['stage5.property_cpu6', 'stage5.property_cpu7'],
                          'measured_blocks': run['measured_blocks'], 'warmup_blocks': run['warmup_blocks'],
                          'operations_per_arm_block': 2_200_000, 'total_invocations': run['total_invocations'],
                          'total_checked_output_rows': run['total_checked_output_rows']})
    sequence_key = 'stage5.mixed_property_run'
    if sequence_key in original_data:
        sequence = original_data[sequence_key]
        require(sequence['producer']['sha256'] == evidence['stage5.mixed_property_recipe']['sha256'],
                'mixed-property sequence producer differs')
        for phase in sequence['phases']:
            key = 'stage5.mixed_property_cpu' + str(phase['cpu'])
            if evidence.get(key, {}).get('available'):
                require(phase['output']['sha256'] == evidence[key]['sha256']
                        and phase['output']['bytes'] == evidence[key]['bytes'],
                        'mixed-property sequence output identity differs')
    integrity.append({'phase': 'stage5_property_companion',
                      'relationship': 'exact historical workload source, standalone builds, preserved phase graphs/profiles and available timing cohorts are linked within their own companion scope',
                      'source_sha256': manifest['source']['sha256'],
                      'reported_scope': manifest['scope'], 'reported_policy': manifest['policy'],
                      'fixture_hashes': {side: manifest['builds'][side]['sha256'] for side in ('reference', 'candidate')}})


def check_test_only_repair(original_data, evidence, integrity):
    for name in ('view_builders', 'designer_schema', 'idioms'):
        key = f'stage5.source_guard_{name}'
        recipe_key = key + '_recipe'
        if key in original_data and evidence.get(recipe_key, {}).get('available'):
            require(original_data[key]['source_sha256'] == evidence[recipe_key]['sha256'],
                    f'{key}: original guard producer differs from retained recipe')

    plan_key = 'stage5.scanner_repair_plan'
    if plan_key not in original_data:
        return
    plan = original_data[plan_key]
    source_key = 'stage5.source'
    if source_key in original_data:
        require(plan['measured_source_snapshot_sha256'] == evidence[source_key]['sha256'],
                'scanner repair plan identifies a different measured snapshot')
        for change in plan['changes']:
            require(original_data[source_key]['source_hashes'][change['path']] == change['before_sha256'],
                    'scanner test-only repair before-hash differs from measured source')
    publication_key = 'stage5.publication_map'
    if publication_key in original_data:
        require(plan['measured_source_commit'] == original_data[publication_key]['published_commit'],
                'scanner repair plan identifies a different measured-source publication')
    for suffix, expected in (
            ('patch', plan['patch_sha256']),
            ('recipe', plan['planned_validation']['recipe_sha256'])):
        key = f'stage5.scanner_repair_{suffix}'
        if evidence.get(key, {}).get('available'):
            require(evidence[key]['sha256'] == expected, f'{key}: prepared repair identity changed')
    guard_files = {'view_builders': 'scripts_generate_view_builders.json',
                   'designer_schema': 'src_FerroUI.Designer.Language_generate_schema.json',
                   'idioms': 'scripts_idioms_inventory.json'}
    for name, filename in guard_files.items():
        key = f'stage5.source_guard_{name}'
        if evidence.get(key, {}).get('available'):
            captured = plan['original_source_guard_results'][filename]
            require(captured['sha256'] == evidence[key]['sha256']
                    and captured['data'] == original_data[key],
                    f'{key}: original failure/guard record differs from repair plan')

    result_key = 'stage5.scanner_repair_results'
    if result_key not in original_data:
        return
    result = original_data[result_key]
    for suffix in ('plan', 'patch', 'recipe'):
        key = f'stage5.scanner_repair_{suffix}'
        require(result[suffix]['sha256'] == evidence[key]['sha256'],
                f'scanner repair result names a different {suffix}')
    require(result['measured_source_commit'] == plan['measured_source_commit']
            and result['measured_source_snapshot']['sha256'] == plan['measured_source_snapshot_sha256']
            and result['expected_test_only_changes'] == plan['changes'],
            'scanner repair result differs from its separate test-only plan')
    before = result['recorded_source_hashes_before']
    if source_key in original_data:
        require(before == original_data[source_key]['source_hashes'],
                'scanner repair rewrote the measured source hash cohort')
    expected = dict(before)
    expected.update({item['path']: item['after_sha256'] for item in plan['changes']})
    require(result['current_source_hashes'] == expected,
            'scanner repair changed additional measured source inputs')
    reported = summaries(result['scanner']['stdout'] + result['scanner']['stderr'])[-1]
    if 'counts' in result['scanner']:
        require(all(result['scanner']['counts'][name] == reported[name]
                    for name in ('passed', 'failed', 'ignored')),
                'scanner repair test counts differ from its captured output')
    for suffix in ('cargo_manifest', 'cargo_lock'):
        key = f'stage5.scanner_repair_{suffix}'
        if evidence.get(key, {}).get('available'):
            require(result[suffix]['sha256'] == evidence[key]['sha256'],
                    f'scanner replay {suffix} differs from retained text')
    integrity.append({'phase': 'stage5_test_only_repair',
                      'relationship': 'original guard failure and measured snapshot remain separate from the later two-file test-only repair and verification',
                      'measured_source_commit': plan['measured_source_commit'],
                      'test_only_changed_paths': [item['path'] for item in plan['changes']],
                      'unchanged_recorded_source_count': sum(expected[name] == value for name, value in before.items()),
                      'reported_repair_status': result['status']})
    publication_key = 'stage5.scanner_repair_publication'
    if publication_key in original_data:
        bridge = original_data[publication_key]
        require(bridge['runtime_source_commit'] == plan['measured_source_commit']
                and bridge['patch_sha256'] == plan['patch_sha256']
                and bridge['verification']['sha256'] == evidence[result_key]['sha256'],
                'test-only publication bridge differs from measured source/repair verification')
        published_paths = {item['path'] for item in bridge['published_files']}
        expected_paths = {item['path'] for item in plan['changes']}
        require(published_paths == expected_paths, 'test-only publication file set differs from reviewed patch')
        commit = bridge['test_only_commit']
        tree = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', commit + '^{tree}'], cwd=REPO, text=True).strip()
        changed = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', bridge['runtime_source_commit'], commit, '--'],
                                          cwd=REPO, text=True).splitlines()
        require(tree == bridge['tree'] and set(changed) == expected_paths,
                'test-only published commit changes more than the reviewed fixture/test pair')
        for item in bridge['published_files']:
            blob = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', commit + ':' + item['path']], cwd=REPO)
            git_blob = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', commit + ':' + item['path']], cwd=REPO, text=True).strip()
            require(sha_bytes(blob) == item['sha256'] == expected[item['path']]
                    and len(blob) == item['bytes'] and git_blob == item['blob_sha'],
                    'test-only published bytes differ from verified repair')
        integrity.append({'phase': 'stage5_test_only_repair',
                          'relationship': 'separate published test-only commit contains exactly the verified two-file delta from the immutable measured runtime commit',
                          'runtime_source_commit': bridge['runtime_source_commit'],
                          'test_only_commit': commit, 'tree': tree, 'changed_paths': sorted(changed)})


def load_published_checkpoint(path):
    identity = json.loads(path.read_text())
    object_name = identity['evidence_commit'] + ':' + identity['repository_path']
    blob_id = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', '--verify', object_name], cwd=REPO, text=True).strip()
    require(blob_id == identity['git_blob'], 'inherited checkpoint Git blob differs from its publication record')
    blob = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'cat-file', 'blob', blob_id], cwd=REPO)
    require(len(blob) == identity['bytes'] and sha_bytes(blob) == identity['sha256'],
            'inherited checkpoint byte identity differs')
    report = json.loads(blob)
    require(report['mode'] == 'final' and report['complete_required_evidence'] and not report['pending_evidence'],
            'inherited checkpoint does not contain complete evidence')
    return identity, report


def assemble(records, final, config_path, publication_commit, final_phase, repository_paths, assessment=None,
             inherited_identity=None, inherited_report=None):
    evidence, original_data, pending, files = {}, {}, [], {}
    inherited_ids = []
    for spec in records:
        key = spec['id']
        if inherited_report and key in inherited_report['evidence']:
            record = copy.deepcopy(inherited_report['evidence'][key])
            require(record['phase'] == spec['phase'] and record['kind'] == spec['kind'],
                    f'{key}: inherited evidence schema differs from its specification')
            if 'data' in record:
                original_data[key] = copy.deepcopy(record['data'])
            elif spec['kind'] not in ('binary', 'file_reference'):
                relative = record.get('repository_path')
                require(relative, f'{key}: inherited separate audit has no durable repository mapping')
                blob = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', inherited_identity['evidence_commit'] + ':' + relative], cwd=REPO)
                require(sha_bytes(blob) == record['sha256'], f'{key}: inherited separate audit differs from its published identity')
                original_data[key] = validate(spec['kind'], pointer(json.loads(blob), spec['selector']))
            evidence[key] = record
            inherited_ids.append(key)
            continue
        record = {'phase': spec['phase'], 'kind': spec['kind'], 'json_pointer': spec['selector']}
        if key in repository_paths:
            record['repository_path'] = repository_paths[key]
        try:
            path_value = spec['path']
            if path_value is None and spec['path_from']:
                origin = spec['path_from']
                path_value = pointer(original_data[origin['artifact']], origin['pointer'])
            require(path_value is not None, 'path not configured')
            path = Path(path_value).resolve()
            record['path'] = str(path)
            if spec['kind'] in ('binary', 'file_reference'):
                record.update(file_identity(path))
                data = None
            else:
                if path not in files:
                    blob = path.read_bytes()
                    files[path] = (blob, sha_bytes(blob))
                blob, sha = files[path]
                record.update(bytes=len(blob), sha256=sha)
                raw = blob.decode('utf-8')
                parsed = raw if spec['kind'] in ('test_log', 'text_log') else json.loads(raw)
                if spec['kind'] in ('final_codegen_reference', 'static_weak_root_audit_reference'):
                    record['reported_status'] = parsed.get('status')
                data = validate(spec['kind'], pointer(parsed, spec['selector']))
                original_data[key] = data
                view = selected_view(spec['kind'], data)
                if view is not None:
                    record['data'] = view
                else:
                    record['storage'] = 'separate compact audit; contents intentionally not duplicated'
            if spec['expected']:
                expected = spec['expected']
                provenance = original_data[expected['artifact']]
                require(record['sha256'] == pointer(provenance, expected['sha256']), 'artifact SHA differs from its provenance')
                if expected['bytes']:
                    require(record['bytes'] == pointer(provenance, expected['bytes']), 'artifact size differs from its provenance')
                record['identity_verified_against'] = expected
            record['available'] = True
        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, IndexError) as error:
            if spec['phase'] not in DRAFT_PHASES or final:
                raise ValueError(f'{key}: {error}') from error
            record.update(available=False, unavailable_reason=str(error))
            pending.append({'artifact': key, 'path': record.get('path'), 'reason': str(error)})
        evidence[key] = record

    # Match categories, generated output and verification to their own recorded cohort.
    integrity, profile_relationships = [], []
    prefixes = ['combined', 'stage2', 'stage3'] + (['stage4'] if final_phase in ('stage4', 'stage5') else [])
    if final_phase == 'stage5':
        prefixes.append('stage5')
    for prefix in prefixes:
        keys = [f'{prefix}.binary', f'{prefix}.attribution', f'{prefix}.source', f'{prefix}.graph']
        if not all(evidence[key]['available'] for key in keys):
            continue
        binary, attribution = evidence[keys[0]], original_data[keys[1]]
        require(binary['sha256'] == attribution['shipping_sha256'] and binary['bytes'] == attribution['shipping_bytes'],
                f'{prefix}: attribution/executable identity mismatch')
        integrity.append({'phase': evidence[keys[0]]['phase'], 'relationship': 'attribution names the exact executable',
                          'sha256': binary['sha256']})
        graph = original_data[f'{prefix}.graph']
        bases = [value for name, value in graph.items() if name.startswith('libferroui_base-') and name.endswith('.rlib')]
        require(len(bases) == 1, f'{prefix}: graph must identify one Base rlib')
        for suffix in ('qa_build', 'registry', 'unwind'):
            key = f'{prefix}.{suffix}'
            if key in evidence and evidence[key]['available']:
                require(original_data[key]['base_sha256'] == bases[0], f'{key}: Base hash differs from phase graph')
        if prefix == 'combined':
            continue
        build_key = f'{prefix}.build_provenance' if prefix in ('stage4', 'stage5') else f'{prefix}.retraining'
        training_key = f'{prefix}.profile_training' if prefix in ('stage4', 'stage5') else build_key
        build = original_data[build_key] if evidence[build_key]['available'] else None
        training = original_data[training_key] if evidence[training_key]['available'] else None
        source = original_data[f'{prefix}.source']['source_hashes']
        if build is not None:
            require(source == build['source']['source_hashes'],
                    f'{prefix}: build source differs from its own source snapshot')
        if build is not None and training is not None:
            require(build['profile']['sha256'] == training['profile']['sha256'],
                    f'{prefix}: build profile differs from supplied training provenance')
            training_matches_source = source == training['source']['source_hashes']
            if prefix not in ('stage4', 'stage5'):
                require(training_matches_source, f'{prefix}: retraining source differs from source snapshot')
            profile_relationships.append({
                'phase': PHASE_NAMES[prefix], 'build_artifact': build_key,
                'training_artifact': training_key, 'profile_sha256': build['profile']['sha256'],
                'training_source_matches_build_source': training_matches_source,
                'reported_training_method': training['method'],
                'reported_training_run_count': len(training['training_runs']),
                'same_profile_identity_as': [prior_key for prior, prior_key in (
                    ('stage2', 'stage2.retraining'), ('stage3', 'stage3.retraining'),
                    ('stage4', 'stage4.profile_training'), ('stage5', 'stage5.profile_training'))
                                             if prior != prefix and prior_key in original_data
                                             and original_data[prior_key]['profile']['sha256']
                                             == build['profile']['sha256']],
                'scope': 'Identity relationships only. A profile hash match or source match does not by itself establish fresh training or throughput acceptance.',
            })
        base_key = f'{prefix}.base_result'
        if base_key in evidence and evidence[base_key]['available']:
            require(original_data[base_key]['sha256'] == bases[0],
                    f'{base_key}: Base hash differs from phase graph')
        if prefix in ('stage3', 'stage4', 'stage5'):
            for suffix in ('registration_cpu6', 'registration_cpu7'):
                key = f'{prefix}.{suffix}'
                if evidence[key]['available']:
                    run = original_data[key]
                    recorded_bases = [sha for name, sha in run['inputs']['candidate']['rlib_sha256'].items()
                                      if name.startswith('libferroui_base-')]
                    require(recorded_bases == bases, f'{key}: candidate Base differs from its phase graph')
                    if build is not None:
                        require(run['inputs']['candidate']['profile_sha256'] == build['profile']['sha256'],
                                f'{key}: profile differs from its phase build provenance')
            audit_key = f'{prefix}.codegen_audit'
            registration_key = f'{prefix}.registration_cpu6'
            if evidence[audit_key]['available']:
                audit = original_data[audit_key]
                require(audit['optimized_base']['sha256'] == bases[0],
                        f'{prefix} codegen audit names a different Base')
                if evidence[registration_key]['available']:
                    fixture = original_data[registration_key]['builds']['candidate']['registration']
                    require(audit['final_native_lookup']['binary_sha256'] == fixture['sha256'],
                            f'{prefix} native audit names a different registration executable')

    # Keep the Base-only clone experiment bound to its own source, graph and fixture.
    clone_build = original_data['inline_clone.base_build']
    clone_graph = original_data['inline_clone.graph']
    clone_bases = [sha for name, sha in clone_graph.items()
                   if name.startswith('libferroui_base-') and name.endswith('.rlib')]
    require(clone_bases == [clone_build['base_sha256']], 'inline clone: Base differs from diagnostic graph')
    clone_fixture = original_data['inline_clone.fixture_build']
    clone_audit = original_data['inline_clone.pgo_codegen_audit']
    clone_native = original_data['inline_clone.final_native_proof']
    clone_timing = original_data['inline_clone.registration_cpu6']
    require(clone_fixture['identity']['base_sha256'] == clone_bases[0]
            and clone_audit['rlib_sha256'] == clone_bases[0], 'inline clone: fixture/audit Base mismatch')
    require(clone_audit['source_value_type_sha256'] == clone_build['source_after_sha256'],
            'inline clone: codegen source differs from diagnostic source')
    require(evidence['inline_clone.source_patch']['sha256'] == clone_build['patch_sha256'],
            'inline clone: source patch differs from diagnostic build')
    require(clone_native['binary_sha256'] == clone_fixture['sha256']
            and clone_native['manifest_sha256'] == evidence['inline_clone.fixture_build']['sha256'],
            'inline clone: native proof names a different fixture or build manifest')
    require(clone_audit['final_native_proof']['native_object_sha256'] == clone_native['native_object_sha256'],
            'inline clone: embedded and standalone native proofs differ')
    require(clone_audit['diagnostic_timing']['sha256'] == evidence['inline_clone.registration_cpu6']['sha256']
            and clone_timing['candidate_build']['sha256'] == clone_fixture['sha256'],
            'inline clone: timing provenance differs from fixture/audit')
    if 'stage3.retraining' in original_data:
        require(clone_fixture['identity']['profile_sha256'] == original_data['stage3.retraining']['profile']['sha256'],
                'inline clone: fixture does not use the recorded inherited stage3 profile')
    integrity.append({'phase': 'inline_clone_diagnostic',
                      'relationship': 'source patch, Base graph, fixture, native audit and raw timing identify the same diagnostic',
                      'base_sha256': clone_bases[0], 'binary_sha256': clone_fixture['sha256'],
                      'profile_sha256': clone_fixture['identity']['profile_sha256']})

    for prefix in ('stage4', 'stage5'):
        if prefix + '.source' in original_data:
            check_stage_companions(prefix, original_data, evidence, integrity)

    if 'stage4.checkpoint_publication' in original_data:
        checkpoint = original_data['stage4.checkpoint_publication']
        if inherited_identity == checkpoint:
            blob_id = inherited_identity['git_blob']
        else:
            checked_identity, _ = load_published_checkpoint(Path(evidence['stage4.checkpoint_publication']['path']))
            blob_id = checked_identity['git_blob']
        require(checkpoint['source_commit'] == original_data['stage4.publication_map']['published_commit'],
                'stage4 evidence publication is linked to a different source publication')
        integrity.append({'phase': 'stage4_checkpoint_publication',
                          'relationship': 'immutable prior evidence commit/blob retained separately from its measured-source publication',
                          'evidence_commit': checkpoint['evidence_commit'],
                          'source_commit': checkpoint['source_commit'], 'git_blob': blob_id,
                          'sha256': checkpoint['sha256']})

    check_static_weak_root(original_data, evidence, integrity)
    if final_phase == 'stage5':
        check_test_only_repair(original_data, evidence, integrity)
        check_property_companion(original_data, evidence, integrity)

    new_records = [record for record in records if record['id'] not in inherited_ids]
    new_data = {key: value for key, value in original_data.items() if key not in inherited_ids}
    source_appendix = build_source_appendix(new_records, final_phase, REPO, RUN, QA, new_data, evidence,
                                           inherited_source=inherited_report)
    unresolved_final_sources = [item for item in source_appendix['unresolved_recorded_sources']
                                if item['artifact'].startswith(final_phase + '.')]
    if final:
        require(not unresolved_final_sources, f'{final_phase}: retained entry source differs from its build provenance')

    published = None
    if publication_commit:
        commit = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', '--verify', '--end-of-options',
                                          publication_commit + '^{commit}'], cwd=REPO, text=True).strip()
        snapshot_key = f'{final_phase}.source'
        require(snapshot_key in original_data, f'publication mapping requires {snapshot_key}')
        snapshot = original_data[snapshot_key]
        checked = {}
        for path, expected_sha in snapshot['source_hashes'].items():
            actual_sha = sha_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'{commit}:{path}'], cwd=REPO))
            require(actual_sha == expected_sha, f'published source differs from {final_phase} snapshot: {path}')
            checked[path] = actual_sha
        checked_reproduction = {}
        for location in source_appendix['source_locations'].values():
            path = location.get('repository_path')
            if not path or path in checked_reproduction:
                continue
            actual_sha = sha_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'{commit}:{path}'], cwd=REPO))
            require(actual_sha == location['sha256'], f'published reproduction source differs: {path}')
            checked_reproduction[path] = actual_sha
        published = {'source_commit': commit, 'selected_final_phase': final_phase, 'snapshot_artifact': snapshot_key,
                     'snapshot_sha256': evidence[snapshot_key]['sha256'], 'recorded_snapshot_head': snapshot['head'],
                     'verified_source_hashes': checked,
                     'verified_reproduction_source_hashes': checked_reproduction,
                     'scope': 'Captured final snapshot files and separately listed reproduction-source mappings are checked byte-for-byte. Original dirty-tree and historical run evidence is unchanged.'}

    phases = {}
    for key, item in evidence.items():
        phases.setdefault(item['phase'], {'artifact_ids': []})['artifact_ids'].append(key)
    phases['historical_precompaction_context']['scope'] = (
        'Category attribution belongs to its recorded 28,324,712-byte pre-compaction ELF; '
        'it is not relabeled as retained/matched compact-unwind attribution.')
    phases['inline_hash_diagnostic']['scope'] = (
        'One-annotation diagnostic using the inherited stage2 profile; CGU/profile drift means '
        'these measurements are not substituted for either whole-application cohort.')
    phases['inline_clone_diagnostic']['scope'] = (
        'Base-only manual Clone diagnostic using the inherited stage3 profile. The Cargo stop after '
        'Base is recorded explicitly and is not a successful whole-application build. Public impl '
        'manglings and root CGU identities drift; these fixture measurements establish neither '
        'fresh-profile throughput nor a final promotion decision.')
    phases[PHASE_NAMES['stage3']]['scope'] = (
        'Stage3 remains a separate source/profile cohort. Its codegen audit diagnoses the residual '
        'outlined boxed-conversion clone; its measurements are not overwritten by later trials.')
    if final_phase in ('stage4', 'stage5'):
        phases[PHASE_NAMES['stage4']]['scope'] = (
            'The selected later candidate has its own build/source and profile-training provenance. '
            'The phase name makes no claim of fresh training, a passing gate, or promotion.')
        phases['stage4_hot_reload_verification']['scope'] = (
            'Separate development configuration with debug assertions and hot-reload enabled in '
            'both Base and the QA harness. It is not part of the release graph, release QA count, '
            'or measured performance cohorts; actual commands and test results remain separate.')
        phases['stage4_template_verification']['scope'] = (
            'Separate template correctness companion built with ThinLTO against the preserved '
            'final release libraries. Its link policy differs from the shipping FatLTO executable. '
            'Archive and tree assertions are correctness evidence, not training or timing samples.')
        phases['stage4_boxed_rejection_followup']['scope'] = (
            'Bounded longer-run boxed rejection/success diagnostic with the unchanged registration '
            'binaries, a second invocation of the exact reference image, and rotated process orders. '
            'Its raw samples supplement the original stage4 cohorts without pooling, replacing, '
            'or relabeling their reported slowdowns; no automatic acceptance decision is made.')
        phases['stage4_checkpoint_publication']['scope'] = (
            'The immutable published stage4 evidence commit is distinct from the source commit '
            'that reproduces its captured production bytes. Later diagnostic records do not '
            'rewrite that checkpoint or change its unresolved acceptance state.')
        phases['static_weak_root_diagnostic']['scope'] = (
            'Separate Base-only weak-root static-callback trial using the inherited stage4 profile. '
            'Only Base changes in the retained target graph; downstream framework crates are not '
            'rebuilt. Root CGU/profile drift prevents whole-application or fresh-profile acceptance '
            'inferences. The source review is its original pre-execution preparation record; '
            'build, native proof, short comparison and longer controls retain their own results.')
    if final_phase == 'stage5':
        phases[PHASE_NAMES['stage5']]['scope'] = (
            'Separate whole-application source/build cohort for the weak-root callback change. '
            'Its actual profile-training provenance, final libraries, native proof and held-out '
            'functional/performance records determine the evidence; diagnostic timings are not substituted.')
        phases['stage5_hot_reload_verification']['scope'] = (
            'Separate final-source development build with debug assertions and hot-reload in both '
            'Base and QA. Its libraries and counts are distinct from release QA and stage4 verification.')
        phases['stage5_template_verification']['scope'] = (
            'Separate ThinLTO template correctness companion against the actual stage5 final libraries; '
            'different link policy from the shipping FatLTO image, and no additional profile training.')
        phases['stage5_boxed_rejection_followup']['scope'] = (
            'Longer balanced-order rejection/success checks of the actual stage5 registration binaries '
            'with a same-image reference control. These records supplement, rather than pool with, '
            'short registration cohorts or earlier source/profile diagnostics.')
        phases['stage5_borrowed_rejection_followup']['scope'] = (
            'Separate borrowed-wrong-only balanced-order control using the actual stage5 binaries. '
            'Its selected-lane recipe and samples remain distinct from the original two-lane boxed '
            'follow-ups, short cohorts and inherited-profile trial that first flagged borrowed misses.')
        phases['stage5_source_guards']['scope'] = (
            'Original repository guard invocations, including the failing scanner fixture idiom '
            'inventory, retained without relabeling them after a test-only repair.')
        phases['stage5_test_only_repair']['scope'] = (
            'Separate two-file mock-trait rename and scanner/idioms verification after runtime '
            'measurement. It does not rewrite the b281 measured source snapshot or count as another '
            'runtime source/build cohort; the real public interface and idioms baseline remain unchanged.')
        phases['stage5_property_companion']['scope'] = (
            'Separate eleven-lane property/dispatch fixture linked against the matched reference '
            'and actual stage5 graphs/profiles with production opt-z, FatLTO and compact unwind. '
            'The exact property_work source was included in the instrumented training main, '
            'but is absent from the optimized shipping main, which matches winui.rs. These '
            'standalone timings are distinct from full-executable startup and the held-out '
            'binding/registration workloads; workload inclusion alone does not establish that '
            'all standalone fixture profile keys matched.')
        phases['stage5_mixed_property_followup']['scope'] = (
            'Separate bounded follow-up to the original CPU7 mixed-property flag, using the '
            'unchanged standalone binaries and a same-image reference control. Each arm/block '
            'aggregates only the mixed lane over eleven original rotation invocations and '
            '2.2 million operations. Other output lanes are retained for correctness only. '
            'The longer aggregate cohort does not replace, pool with or relabel the original flag.')
        phases['stage5_repository_observation']['scope'] = (
            'Dated repository/Actions observation, separate from local validation and the frozen '
            'runtime/test-only publications. It makes no current-main integration or CI-green claim.')
    sizes = {}
    retained = evidence['baseline.retained_binary']['bytes']
    matched = evidence['baseline.matched_binary']['bytes']
    for key in ['baseline.retained_binary', 'baseline.matched_binary'] + [f'{prefix}.binary' for prefix in prefixes]:
        item = evidence[key]
        if item['available']:
            sizes[key] = {'bytes': item['bytes'], 'sha256': item['sha256'],
                          'difference_from_retained_bytes': item['bytes'] - retained,
                          'difference_from_matched_bytes': item['bytes'] - matched}
    tests = {key: item['data']['reported_test_summaries'] for key, item in evidence.items()
             if item['available'] and item['kind'] == 'test_log'}
    for key, item in evidence.items():
        if item['available'] and item['kind'] == 'verification' and 'test result:' in item['data']['output']:
            tests[key] = summaries(item['data']['output'])
        if item['available'] and item['kind'] == 'scanner_repair':
            tests[key] = summaries(item['data']['scanner']['stdout'] + item['data']['scanner']['stderr'])
    worktree = {'repository': str(REPO), 'head': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=REPO, text=True).strip(),
                'status': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--short'], cwd=REPO, text=True).splitlines(),
                'diff_against_head_sha256': sha_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--binary', 'HEAD'], cwd=REPO))}
    return {
        'schema_version': 3, 'subject': 'FerroUI PR496 Rust idioms continuation: evidence assembly',
        'assembled_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'mode': 'final' if final else 'work_draft',
        'selected_final_phase': final_phase,
        'reported_checkpoint_assessment': assessment,
        'inherited_evidence_checkpoint': inherited_identity,
        'inherited_artifact_ids': inherited_ids,
        'purpose': 'Audit assembly only. Completeness is availability, not a passing performance verdict or promotion decision.',
        'cohort_policy': 'Keep each run, source/profile identity and reported sample/test count separate. No pooled cohorts or automatic attribution to the hasher.',
        'cohort_qualifications': [{
            'artifacts': ['stage2.startup_cpu6', 'stage2.startup_cpu7', 'stage3.startup_cpu6', 'stage3.startup_cpu7'],
            'basis': 'Protocol qualification recorded during the continuation; preserved recipe files and final protocol fields are retained separately.',
            'stage2': 'Both FERROUI_BENCH_EXPECT_NORMAL_FONT_SIZE and FERROUI_BENCH_EXPECT_COMPACT_FONT_SIZE were set; their checking work ran after the ready marker.',
            'stage3': 'Stage3 timing recipes unset both variables equally for reference and candidate; compatibility uses separate launches. Raw protocol flags and internal phases are preserved.',
            'limit': 'Do not attribute cross-stage startup differences solely to source changes or the hash-inline fix. Paired within-run comparisons retain their own protocol.',
        }],
        'complete_required_evidence': not pending, 'pending_evidence': pending,
        'published_source_mapping': published,
        'assembler': file_identity(Path(__file__)), 'configuration': file_identity(config_path) if config_path else None,
        'assembly_worktree': worktree, 'phases': phases, 'verified_binary_sizes': sizes,
        'identity_relationships_checked': integrity, 'profile_provenance_relationships': profile_relationships,
        'reported_test_summaries_by_artifact': tests,
        'compatibility_cases_by_artifact': {key: sorted(item['data']) for key, item in evidence.items()
                                            if item['available'] and item['kind'] == 'compatibility'},
        'evidence': evidence,
        **source_appendix,
        'interpretation_limits': [
            'Legacy full-app and binding timing JSONs do not embed executable hashes; their original schemas and supplied cohort paths are retained without manufacturing missing identities.',
            'Pre-compaction category attribution is context only; exact retained/matched allocated and file sections are supplied by the recovered/section-comparison evidence.',
            'Separate compact PGO/codegen audit links carry their own hashes and scopes; raw LLVM/native records are not duplicated here.',
            'Stage4 profile use is recorded separately from training. Only supplied build/training provenance establishes whether a profile was reused or retrained; no phase label manufactures that fact.',
            'This assembler does not run a compiler, benchmark or correctness executable and does not infer gate success from file existence.',
        ],
    }


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--config', type=Path, help='default: <final-phase>-paths.json beside this script')
    parser.add_argument('--out', type=Path, default=OUTPUT)
    parser.add_argument('--final', action='store_true', help='require complete evidence; does not require/declare promotion')
    parser.add_argument('--final-phase', choices=('stage3', 'stage4', 'stage5'), default='stage5',
                        help='selected source/build cohort for final identity checks (default: stage5)')
    parser.add_argument('--publication-commit', help='map captured final source hashes to an existing commit without modifying raw evidence')
    parser.add_argument('--print-final-paths', action='store_true', help='print a path template without reading evidence')
    parser.add_argument('--print-stage3-paths', action='store_true', help='print the historical stage3 path template only')
    parser.add_argument('--sources-only', type=Path, metavar='OUTPUT',
                        help='capture only small retained source texts; do not read/hash build artifacts')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    records = specifications(args.final_phase)
    if args.print_final_paths or args.print_stage3_paths:
        selected = ('stage3' if args.print_stage3_paths else args.final_phase) + '.'
        print(json.dumps({'paths': {r['id']: r['path'] for r in records
                                   if r['id'].startswith(selected) and not r['path_from']},
                          'selectors': {r['id']: r['selector'] for r in records
                                        if r['id'].startswith(selected) and r['selector']},
                          'repository_paths': {}}, indent=2))
        return
    config_path = (args.config or HERE / f'{args.final_phase}-paths.json').resolve()
    config = json.loads(config_path.read_text())
    require(set(config) <= {'paths', 'selectors', 'repository_paths', 'assessment', 'extend_checkpoint'}, 'unknown configuration fields')
    require(config.get('assessment') is None or isinstance(config['assessment'], dict), 'invalid checkpoint assessment')
    known = {r['id'] for r in records}
    for field in ('paths', 'selectors', 'repository_paths'):
        require(set(config.get(field, {})) <= known, f'unknown artifact IDs in {field}')
    audit_ids = {r['id'] for r in records if r['kind'] in ('reference', 'final_codegen_reference',
                                                        'static_weak_root_audit_reference')}
    for key, value in config.get('repository_paths', {}).items():
        require(key in audit_ids, f'{key}: repository mapping must name a separate audit')
        require(isinstance(value, str) and bool(value) and not Path(value).is_absolute()
                and '..' not in Path(value).parts, f'{key}: invalid repository-relative audit path')
    repository_paths = REPOSITORY_AUDIT_PATHS | config.get('repository_paths', {})
    for record in records:
        if record['id'] in config.get('paths', {}):
            record['path'] = config['paths'][record['id']]
            record['path_from'] = None
        if record['id'] in config.get('selectors', {}):
            record['selector'] = config['selectors'][record['id']]
    inherited_identity, inherited_report = (load_published_checkpoint(Path(config['extend_checkpoint']))
                                            if config.get('extend_checkpoint') else (None, None))
    if args.sources_only:
        source_records = [record for record in records
                          if not inherited_report or record['id'] not in inherited_report['evidence']]
        snapshot = build_source_appendix(source_records, args.final_phase, REPO, RUN, QA,
                                         inherited_source=inherited_report)
        output = args.sources_only.resolve()
        output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        temporary = output.with_name(output.name + '.tmp')
        temporary.write_text(json.dumps(snapshot, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n')
        temporary.replace(output)
        print(json.dumps({'output': str(output), 'bytes': output.stat().st_size,
                          **snapshot['source_summary'],
                          'scope': 'Small source extension of any configured immutable checkpoint; new build artifacts were not assembled or hashed.'}, indent=2))
        return
    report = assemble(records, args.final, config_path, args.publication_commit,
                      args.final_phase, repository_paths, config.get('assessment'),
                      inherited_identity, inherited_report)
    args.out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = args.out.with_name(args.out.name + '.tmp')
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n')
    temporary.replace(args.out)
    print(json.dumps({'output': str(args.out.resolve()), 'mode': report['mode'], 'bytes': args.out.stat().st_size,
                      'selected_final_phase': args.final_phase, 'evidence_records': len(report['evidence']),
                      'pending_slots': len(report['pending_evidence'])}, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        main()
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, IndexError) as error:
        print(f'Assembly refused: {error}', file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(2)

original_as_built_hash_comparison.scope: Exact reconstruction uses the retained fixture directory. It does not assert byte equality to all original as-built hashes; the two path-bearing wrapper files have different hashes after fixture-path substitution.

qa_materialization.scope: The existing repository recipe reproduces all retained 21-file QA inputs exactly at the recorded fixture path. registration.rs belongs to the separate registry harness.

source_scope: Exact retained UTF-8 source text is stored once per SHA256. Paths and absolute Rust module attributes remain unchanged.

When extending a published checkpoint, its evidence and source bodies are imported unchanged from the recorded Git blob. Later bodies at the same temporary path are separate SHA256 versions; old producer claims keep their original text.
Temporary paths are original provenance, not portable locations. Reproduction must restore or consistently remap those paths and supply the separately recorded toolchain, profile and library graph.
A matches_recorded_hash claim covers only the entry file actually hashed by that manifest. Dependent-module hashes are retained snapshot identities, not new claims that old manifests hashed them.

Saved Python recipe text is capture-time evidence unless the appendix lists a matching producer hash claim for that exact body. Current recipe text is never silently substituted for a different historical helper hash.

The original 21-file QA extraction recipe is preserved in an existing repository report and its exact reconstruction was checked. The extra registry input and bespoke timing/verification scripts are retained directly as source.
Cargo fingerprint lookup in property-runner.py is local build plumbing; each QA manifest also preserves the resolved rustc command and --extern paths for a direct replay.
interpretation_limits: Legacy full-app and binding timing JSONs do not embed executable hashes; their original schemas and supplied cohort paths are retained without manufacturing missing identities.
Pre-compaction category attribution is context only; exact retained/matched allocated and file sections are supplied by the recovered/section-comparison evidence.
Separate compact PGO/codegen audit links carry their own hashes and scopes; raw LLVM/native records are not duplicated here.
Stage4 profile use is recorded separately from training. Only supplied build/training provenance establishes whether a profile was reused or retrained; no phase label manufactures that fact.
This assembler does not run a compiler, benchmark or correctness executable and does not infer gate success from file existence.
